v: Haton stzolal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Adán tik: Winhaj Set, winhaj Enós,
winhaj Cainán, winhaj Mahalaleel, winhaj Jared,
winhaj Enoc, winhaj Matusalén, winhaj Lamec,
winhaj Noé. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Noé: Haton winhaj Sem, winhaj Cam yet' winhaj Jafet.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jafet chi': Winhaj Gomer, winhaj Magog, winhaj Madai, winhaj Javán, winhaj Tubal, winhaj Mesec yet' winhaj Tiras.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gomer chi': Winhaj Askenaz, winhaj Rifat yet' winhaj Togarma.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Javán chi': Haton winhaj Elisa, winhaj Tarsis, winhaj Quitim yet' winhaj Dodanim.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cam: Haton winhaj Cus, winhaj Mizraim, winhaj Fut, winhaj Canaán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cus chi': Haton winhaj Seba, winhaj Havila, winhaj Sabta, winhaj Raama yet' winhaj Sabteca. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Raama chi': Haton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Ha winhaj Cus chi', haton winh smam winhaj Nimrod. Haton jun winh chi' te niwan ajnak yelk'och t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik yujto te jelan ajnak winh t'a owal.
Ha t'a winhaj Mizraim, hata' kotnak heb' ludeo, heb' anameo, heb' lehabita, heb' naftuhítas,
heb' patruseo, heb' casluhítas yet' heb' caftoritas. Ha t'a heb' chi' kotnak yinhtil heb' filisteo.
Ha winhaj Sidón, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Canaán. Ha junxo yuninal winh, haton winhaj Het.
Ha winhaj Canaán chi' ay yinhtilal heb' jebuseo, heb' amorreo, heb' gergeseo,
heb' heveo, heb' araceo, heb' sineo,
heb' arvadeo, heb' zemareo yet' heb' hamateo.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sem: Haton winhaj Elam, winhaj Asur, winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Lud yet' winhaj Aram. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aram chi': Haton winhaj Uz, winhaj Hul, winhaj Geter yet' winhaj Mesec.
Ha winhaj Arfaxad chi' smam winhaj Sela, haxo winhaj Sela chi' smam winhaj Heber.
Ha winhaj Heber chi', chawanh yuninal winh: Ha winh b'ab'el skuch Peleg, yujto ha t'a stiempoal winh ix pojchajb'at lum lum. Haxo junxo winh yuninal winh chi' skuchan Joctán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Joctán chi': Haton winhaj Almodad, winhaj Selef, winhaj Hazar-mawet, winhaj Jera,
winhaj Adoram, winhaj Uzal, winhaj Dicla,
winhaj Ebal, winhaj Abimael, winhaj Seba,
winhaj Ofir, winhaj Havila yet' winhaj Jobab. Ha masanil heb' winh tik, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Joctán.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sem tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Arfaxad, winhaj Sela,
winhaj Heber, winhaj Peleg, winhaj Reu,
winhaj Serug, winhaj Nacor, winhaj Taré,
yet' winhaj Abram, haton winhaj Abraham.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Abraham: Haton winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Ismael.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ismael: Haton winhaj Nebaiot, b'ab'el yuninal, winhaj Cedar, winhaj Adbeel, winhaj Mibsam,
winhaj Misma, winhaj Duma, winhaj Massa, winhaj Hadad, winhaj Tema,
winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Cedema.

Haxo heb' yune' ix Cetura, schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Abraham chi': Haton winhaj Zimram, winhaj Jocsán, winhaj Medán, winhaj Madián, winhaj Isbac yet' winhaj Súa. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jocsán chi': Haton winhaj Seba yet' winhaj Dedán.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Madián chi': Haton winhaj Efa, winhaj Efer, winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Abida yet' winhaj Elda. Masanil heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh ix Cetura.
Ha winhaj Abraham smam winhaj Isaac. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaac chi', haton winhaj Esaú yet' winhaj Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Esaú chi': Haton winhaj Elifaz, winhaj Reuel, winhaj Jeús, winhaj Jaalam yet' winhaj Coré.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elifaz chi': Haton winhaj Temán, winhaj Omar, winhaj Zefo, winhaj Gatam, winhaj Cenaz yet' winhaj Amalec yune' ix Timna.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Reuel chi': Haton winhaj Nahat, winhaj Zera, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Miza.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Seir: Haton winhaj Lotán, winhaj Sobal, winhaj Zibeón, winhaj Aná, winhaj Disón, winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Disán.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Lotán chi': Haton winhaj Hori yet' winhaj Homam. Ha winhaj Lotán chi' ay yanab' ix Timna.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sobal chi': Haton winhaj Alván, winhaj Manahat, winhaj Ebal, winhaj Sefo yet' winhaj Onam. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zibeón chi': Haton winhaj Aja yet' winhaj Aná.
Ha winhaj Aná chi', smam winhaj Disón, haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Disón chi': Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Esbán, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Querán.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ezer: Haton winhaj Bilhán, winhaj Zaaván yet' winhaj Jaacán. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Disán chi': Haton winhaj Uz yet' winhaj Arán.
Haton heb' winh tik ix ak'an yajalil t'a Edom ayik mantalaj sreyal heb' israel tz'ochi: Ha winhaj Bela yuninal winhaj Beor, Dinaba sb'i schonhab' winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Bela chi', haxo winhaj Jobab yuninal winhaj Zera, aj chonhab' Bosra ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Jobab chi', haxo winhaj Husam ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi', ha t'a yol yik Temán kajan winh.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Husam chi', haxo winhaj Hadad yuninal winhaj Bedad aj chonhab' Avit ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Ha jun winh chi' ix ak'an ganar winhaj Madián t'a ak'lik yik Moab.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', haxo winhaj Samla aj chonhab' Masreca ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Samla chi', haxo winhaj Saúl ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. kajan winh t'a chonhab' Rehobot t'a sti' ha' Éufrates.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Saúl chi', haxo winhaj Baal-hanán, yuninal winhaj Acbor ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh.
Ayik ix cham winhaj Baal-hanán chi', haxo winhaj Hadad aj chonhab' Pai ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok winh. Mehetabel sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh, a winhaj Matred ay yisil ix, yixchikin ix winhaj Mezaab.
Haxo yik ix cham winhaj Hadad chi', a heb' winh ix och reyal t'a Edom chi': Haton winhaj Timna, winhaj Alva, winhaj Jetet,
winhaj Aholibama, winhaj Ela, winhaj Pinón,
winhaj Cenaz, winhaj Temán, winhaj Mibzar,
winhaj Magdiel yet' winhaj Iram. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix ak'an reyal t'a Edom chi'.
Haton heb' winh yuninal winhaj Israel tik: Winhaj Rubén, winhaj Simeón, winhaj Leví, winhaj Judá, winhaj Isacar, winhaj Zabulón,
winhaj Dan, winhaj José, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Neftalí, winhaj Gad yet' winhaj Aser.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá: Haton winhaj Er, winhaj Onán yet' winhaj Sela. Ha snun heb' winh oxwanh tik, haton ix yisil winhaj Súa aj Canaán. Ha winhaj Er chi' b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Judá, te chuk sb'eyb'al winh, yuj chi' ix satjiel winh yuj Jehová.
Haxo ix Tamar, ix yalib' winhaj Judá chi', ay chawanh yune' ix yet' winh: Haton winhaj Fares yet' winhaj Zera. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Judá chi' owanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Fares chi': Haton winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Hamul.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zera chi': Haton winhaj Zimri, winhaj Etán, winhaj Hemán, winhaj Calcol yet' winhaj Dara. Owanh heb' t'a smasanil.
Haxo winhaj Carmi smam winhaj Acán. Ha winhaj Acán chi' ix ik'ankot yaelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel, yujto ix yik'kot juntzanh tas winh t'a skal tas ix yal Dios to satjiel t'a junelnhej.
Haxo yuninal winhaj Etán, haton winhaj Azarías.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hezrón: Haton winhaj Jerameel, winhaj Ram yet' winhaj Quelubai.
Ha winhaj Ram chi' smam winhaj Aminadab. Haxo winhaj Aminadab chi' smam winhaj Naasón. Ha winhaj Naasón yajal ix aj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Judá.
Ha winhaj Naasón chi' smam winhaj Salmón. Ha winhaj Salmón chi' smam winhaj Booz.
Ha winhaj Booz chi' smam winhaj Obed, haton winh smam winhaj Isaí.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isaí chi', haton heb' winh tik: B'ab'el winhaj Eliab, schab'il winhaj Abinadab, yoxil winhaj Simea,
schanhil winhaj Natanael, yoil winhaj Radai,
swakil winhaj Ozem, yukil winhaj David.
Eb' ix yanab' heb' winh tik: Haton ix Sarvia yet' ix Abigail. Haxo heb' winh yune' ix Sarvia chi', oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Abisai, winhaj Joab, winhaj Asael.
Haxo winh yune' ix Abigail chi', haton winhaj Amasa. Ha winh smam winhaj Amasa chi', haton winhaj Jeter ismaelita.
Haxo winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Hezrón, ay jun yuninal winh skuch Jeriot, yune' ix Azuba. Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh yune' ix: Haton winhaj Jeser, winhaj Sobab yet' winhaj Ardón.
Haxo ix cham ix Azuba chi', haxo ix Efrata ix yik' winhaj Caleb chi'. Ay jun yune' ix, haton winhaj Hur.
Ha winhaj Hur chi' smam winhaj Uri. Haxo winhaj Uri chi' smam winhaj Bezaleel.
Ayik 60 ab'ilxo sk'inal winhaj Hezrón, ix yik' ix yisil winhaj Maquir winh, haton winh smam winhaj Galaad. Ix alji jun yune' ix yet' winhaj Hezrón chi', haton winhaj Segub.
Ha winhaj Segub chi' smam winhaj Jair. Ha winhaj Jair chi' ayoch yajalil t'a 23 chonhab' t'a yol smakb'en Galaad.

Haxo pax heb' aj Gesur yet' heb' aj Aram ix ik'ankan juntzanh schonhab' winhaj Jair chi' yet' chonhab' Kenat yet' yaldeail, 60 chonhab'il t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh heb' tik, yinhtilal heb' winhaj Maquir.
Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Hezrón chi', haxo winhaj Caleb ix ik'ankan ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Efrata. Ix alji jun yune' ix, haton winhaj Asur smam yicham heb' aj Tecoa.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jerameel tik, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Hezrón: Winhaj Ram winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Buna, winhaj Orén, winhaj Ozem yet' winhaj Ahías.
Ha winhaj Jerameel chi', ay junxo ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix Atara snun winhaj Onam.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ram tik, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Jerameel: Winhaj Maaz, winhaj Jamín yet' winhaj Equer.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Onam chi': Haton winhaj Samai yet' winhaj Jada. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Samai chi': Haton winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abisur.
Ha ix yetb'eyum winhaj Abisur chi', haton ix Abihail. Ha ix chi' snun winhaj Ahbán yet' winhaj Molid.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Nadab chi': Haton winhaj Seled yet' winhaj Apaim. Ha winhaj Seled chi' malaj yuninal winh.
Haxo winhaj Apaim chi' smam winhaj Isi. Haxo winhaj Isi chi' smam winhaj Sesán. Haxo winhaj Sesán chi' smam winhaj Ahlai.
Haxo winhaj Jada yuk'tak winhaj Samai, a winh smam winhaj Jeter yet' winhaj Jonatán. Ha winhaj Jeter chi' malaj yuninal winh.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi': Haton winhaj Pelet yet' winhaj Zaza. Ha heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Jerameel.
Ha winhaj Sesán, malaj yuninal winh, yuj chi' a junok heb' ix yisil winh ix yik'laj sb'a yet' jun winh schekab' winh skuch Jarha aj Egipto. Ix alji jun yune' ix skuch Atai.

Haton heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Atai t'a stzolal: Winhaj Natán, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Eflal, winhaj Obed, winhaj Jehú, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Heles, winhaj Elasa, winhaj Sismai, winhaj Salum, winhaj Jecamías yet' winhaj Elisama.
Ha winhaj Caleb yuk'tak winhaj Jerameel chi', a winh smam winhaj Mesa b'ab'el yuninal, winhaj Zif yet' winhaj Maresa smam winhaj Hebrón.
Haxo winhaj Hebrón chi' smam winhaj Coré, winhaj Tapúa, winhaj Requem yet' winhaj Sema.
Haton heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Sema t'a stzolal: Winhaj Raham, winhaj Jorcoam, winhaj Requem, winhaj Samai, winhaj Maón yet' winhaj Bet-sur.
Ha ix Efa schab'il yetb'eyum winhaj Caleb, haton ix ay yune' winhaj Harán, winhaj Mosa yet' winhaj Gazez. Haxo winhaj Harán chi' smam junxo winhaj Gazez.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jahdai: Haton winhaj Regem, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Gesam, winhaj Pelet, winhaj Efa yet' winhaj Saaf.

Haxo ix Maaca schab'il pax yetb'eyum winhaj Caleb chi', a ix ay yune' winhaj Seber yet' winhaj Tirhana. Hanheja' ix ay yune' winhaj Saaf smam winhaj Madmana. Hanheja' ix ay yune' winhaj Seva smam winhaj Macbena yet' winhaj Gibea. Haxo ix yisil winhaj Caleb chi', haton ix Acsa.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winhaj Caleb chi'. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hur, winh sb'ab'el une' ix Efrata, haton winhaj Sobal, winh smam yicham heb' aj Quiriat-jearim,
winhaj Salma, smam yicham heb' aj Belén yet' winhaj Haref smam yicham heb' aj Bet-gader.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sobal smam yicham heb' aj Quiriat-jearim: Haton winhaj Haroe, nanhal heb' manahetita,
yet' junjun makan heb' aj Quiriat-jearim: Haton heb' itrita, heb' futita, heb' sumatita yet' heb' misraita. Haton t'a heb' chi' ix kot heb' zoratita yet' heb' estaolita.
Haxo winhaj Salma ix kajnajkan t'a chonhab' Belén. Ha winh smam yicham heb' netofatita, heb' aj Atrot-bet-joab yet' nanhalxo heb' manahetita, heb' zoraíta,
yet' heb' yinhtilal heb' soferita ix ek' kajan t'a Jabes, haton heb' tirateo, heb' simateo yet' heb' sucateo. Yet' heb' ceneo kotnak t'a yinhtilal winhaj Hamat smam yicham heb' yinhtilal Recab.

Ha winhaj rey David nanhal swajxakil ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Hebrón. Ayik ayoch winh reyal t'a Hebrón chi', wakwanh heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji, haton heb' tik: Ha winh b'ab'el, a winhaj Amnón, yune' ix Ahinoam aj Jezreel. Haxo winh schab'il, a winhaj Daniel yune' ix Abigail aj Carmel. Haxo winh yoxil, a winhaj Absalón, yune' ix Maaca, ix yisil winhaj Talmai sreyal Gesur. Haxo winh schanhil, a winhaj Adonías yune' ix Haguit. Haxo winh yoil, a winhaj Sefatías yune' ix Abital. Haxo winh swakil, haton winhaj Itream yune' ix Egla. Ixlajwi chi' 33 ab'il pax ix yak' reyal winhaj David chi' t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ayoch winh reyal t'a Jerusalén chi', 13 to heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Simea, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán yet' winhaj Salomón. Ha heb' winh tik, yune' heb' winh ix Betsabé, ix yisil winhaj Amiel.
Ha juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj David chi': Haton winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Elifelet, winhaj Noga, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Eliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.
Yanab' pax ix Tamar juntzanh heb' winh tik. Ch'ok pax yaj juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' ix schab'il yetb'eyum max b'inajlaj t'a skal heb' winh tik.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Salomón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Roboam, winhaj Abías, winhaj Asa, winhaj Josafat, winhaj Joram, winhaj Ocozías, winhaj Joás, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Jotam, winhaj Acaz, winhaj Ezequías, winhaj Manasés, winhaj Amón yet' winhaj Josías.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Josías chi', winh b'ab'el, a winhaj Johanán, winh schab'il, a winhaj Joacim, winh yoxil, a winhaj Sedequías, winh schanhil a winhaj Salum.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Joacim chi': Haton winhaj Jeconías yet' winhaj Sedequías.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeconías winh ik'b'ilb'at preso t'a Babilonia, haton winhaj Salatiel, winhaj Malquiram, winhaj Pedaías, winhaj Senazar, winhaj Jecamías, winhaj Hosama yet' winhaj Nedabías.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Pedaías, haton winhaj Zorobabel yet' winhaj Simei. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Zorobabel chi': Haton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Hananías yet' pax ix Selomit yanab' heb' winh.
Ay pax owanhxo yuninal winhaj Zorobabel chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hasuba, winhaj Ohel, winhaj Berequías, winhaj Hasadías yet' winhaj Jusab-hesed.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hananías chi': Haton winhaj Pelatías yet' winhaj Jesaías. Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Jesaías chi' t'a stzolal haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Refaías, winhaj Arnán, winhaj Abdías yet' winhaj Secanías.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Secanías chi', haton winhaj Semaías, winhaj Hatús, winhaj Igal, winhaj Barías, winhaj Nearías yet' winhaj Safat. Wakwanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Nearías oxwanh sb'ey heb' winh. Haton winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Ezequías yet' winhaj Azricam.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elioenai chi', ukwanh sb'ey heb' winh: Haton winhaj Hodabías, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Pelaías, winhaj Acub, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Dalaías yet' winhaj Anani.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Judá, haton heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Fares, winhaj Hezrón, winhaj Carmi, winhaj Hur yet' winhaj Sobal.
Ha winhaj Sobal chi' smam winhaj Reaía, smam icham winhaj Jahat. Haxo winhaj Jahat chi' smam winhaj Ahumai yet' winhaj Lahad. Ha yinhtilal heb' winh ix kajnaj t'a Zora.

Ha winhaj Hur sb'ab'el yune' ix Efrata yet' winhaj Caleb. Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winh ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Belén. Ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Etam, winhaj Penuel yet' winhaj Ezer. Ha winhaj Etam smam winhaj Jezreel, winhaj Isma, winhaj Ibdas yet' ix Haze-lelponi. Ha winhaj Penuel chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Gedor, haxo winhaj Ezer chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Husa.
Haxo winhaj Asur ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Tecoa, chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winh: Haton ix Hela yet' ix Naara.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Naara chi', haton winhaj Ahusam, winhaj Hefer, winhaj Temeni yet' winhaj Ahastari.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Hela chi', haton winhaj Seret, winhaj Jezoar yet' winhaj Etnán.
Haxo winhaj Cos smam winhaj Anub yet' winhaj Sobeba. T'a yinhtilal winhaj Cos chi' ix kot winhaj Aharhel, yuninal winhaj Harum.
Ay jun winh skuchan Jabes, te niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha ix snun winh ix ak'an skuch Jabes, yujto ix yal ix: Te ya ix in ek' yuj jun wune' ix alji tik, xchi ix.

Ha winhaj Jabes chi', ix och winh ejmelal t'a sDiosal Israel, ix yalan winh t'ay: Tzin k'an t'ayach Mamin to tzak' a wach'k'olal t'a wib'anh, yik niwan tz'aj in makb'en, to tzach och wet'ok tzin a kolanel t'a chukal, yik wach' max wab' syail, xchi winh t'a slesal chi'. Ix yak'an Dios masanil tas ix sk'an winh chi'.
Ha winhaj Quelub yuk'tak winhaj Súa, a winh smam winhaj Mehir, haxo winhaj Mehir chi', smam winhaj Estón.

Haxo winhaj Estón chi' ay oxwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Bet-rafa, winhaj Paseah yet' winhaj Tehina. Ha winhaj Tehina chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Nahas. Ha heb' yinhtilal heb' winh oxwanh chi' ek'nak kajan t'a Reca.
Haxo winhaj Cenaz ay chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Otoniel yet' winhaj Seraías. Chawanh pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Otoniel chi', haton winhaj Hatat yet' winhaj Meonotai.

Ha winhaj Meonotai chi' smam winhaj Ofra. Haxo winhaj Seraías chi' smam winhaj Joab, haton winh ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a ak'lik Carisim. Icha chi' sb'i jun lugar chi', yujto hata' kajan heb' anima jelan sb'oan tastak.
Haxo winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Iru, winhaj Ela yet' winhaj Naam. Ha winhaj Ela chi' smam winhaj Cenaz.
Haxo winhaj Jahalelel ay chanhwanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Zif, winhaj Zifa, winhaj Tirías yet' winhaj Asareel.

Ha winhaj Esdras ay chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Jeter, winhaj Mered, winhaj Efer yet' winhaj Jalón. Ha winhaj Mered chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Bitia, yisil winh sreyal Egipto. Haxo yalyuninal winh yet' ix, haton ix María, winhaj Samai yet' winhaj Isba. Ha winhaj Isba chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Estemoa. Haxo junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Mered chi', aj Judá ix. Oxwanh yuninal winh yet' ix, haton winhaj Jered, winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Jecutiel. Ha winhaj Jered chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Gedor, haxo winhaj Heber, ha t'a chonhab' Soco ix b'ab'laj kajnaj winh. Haxo pax winhaj Jecutiel chi', ha t'a chonhab' Zanoa ix b'ab'laj kajnaj winh.

Ha winhaj Hodías ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix yanab' winhaj Naham. T'a yinhtilal heb' ix kot heb' garmita, ix kajnaj heb' t'a Keila. Hanheja' t'a yinhtilal winhaj Hodías chi' ix kot heb' maacateo, haxo t'a Estemoa ix kajnaj heb'.
Ha winhaj Simón chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amnón, winhaj Rina, winhaj Ben-hanán yet' winhaj Tilón. Haxo winhaj Isi ay chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Zohet yet' winhaj Benzohet.

Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sela yuninal winhaj Judá, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Er, winh b'ab'laj kajnajnak t'a Leca yet' winhaj Laada, winh b'ab'laj kajnajnak t'a Maresa, smam yicham heb' sch'alan k'apak lino t'a chonhab' Bet-asbea. Hanhejtona' winhaj Er chi' smam winhaj Joacim yet' heb' anima kajan t'a Cozeba yet' winhaj Joás yet' winhaj Saraf. Ha winhaj Joás yet' winhaj Saraf, ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' chawanh heb' ix aj Moab. Slajwi chi' smeltzajnakxi heb' winh t'a Belén, icha chi' yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a peka'.
Ha juntzanh heb' chi' tz'akum heb'. Ha t'a Netaim yet' t'a Gedera kajan heb', yak'nak serwil winh rey heb'.
Ha winhaj Simeón owanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Nemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Jarib, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Saúl.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Salum, winhaj Mibsam, winhaj Misma.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Misma chi', haton winhaj Hamuel, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Simei.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', 16 heb' winh, wakwanh pax heb' ix yisil winh. Haxo pax heb' winh sk'ab'yok winh, malaj wal yuninal heb' winh, yuj chi' maj q'uib' sb'isul heb' winh icha yinhtilal Judá.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Simeón chi' ix kajnaj heb' t'a juntzanh lugar tik: T'a Beerseba, t'a Molada, t'a Hazar-sual, t'a Bilha, t'a Esem, t'a Tolad, t'a Betuel, t'a Horma, t'a Siclag, t'a Bet-marcabot, t'a Hazar-susim, t'a Bet-birai yet' t'a Saaraim. Hata' kajan heb' masanto yik ix och winhaj David reyal.
Ayto pax oyexo schonhab' heb': Haton Etam, Aín, Rimón, Toquén yet' Asán,
yet' masanil yaldeail juntzanh chonhab' chi' masanto t'a chonhab' Baal. Haton juntzanh chonhab' chi' b'aj kajan heb' yet' yinhtilal icha yaj stz'ib'chajkani.

Ayik ix q'uib' sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Simeón chi', haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal heb': Winhaj Mesobab, winhaj Jamlec, winhaj Josías (yuninal winhaj Amasías), winhaj Joel, winhaj Jehú (yuninal winhaj Josibías, haxo winhaj Josibías chi' yuninal winhaj Seraías, haxo winhaj Seraías chi' yuninal winhaj Asiel) yet' pax winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Jaacoba, winhaj Jesohaía, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Adiel, winhaj Jesimiel, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Ziza. (Ha winh smam winhaj Ziza chi' haton winhaj Sifi, yuninal winhaj Alón, yuninal winhaj Jedaías, yuninal winhaj Simri yuninal winhaj Semaías).

Yujto ix q'uib' sb'isul heb', yuj chi' ix b'at heb' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Gedor. Ix sayan heb' b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a jun ch'olan b'aj skan jun chonhab' chi'.

Hata' ix ilchaj anh ank'ultak te yaax yuj heb', te wach' anh, te ay pax anh. Te lewan yek' jun lum lum chi', junk'olal yajek' heb', malaj tas tz'ik'an heb', haton ta' ek'nak kajan heb' yinhtilal Cam t'a peka'.

Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá, hata' ix jawi juntzanh heb' toxo ix b'inaj sb'i tik. Ha heb' satjinakel heb' anima kajan ta' yet' scampamento heb' yet' spat heb'. Junelnhej ix satel heb' smasanil. Haxo heb' ix kajnajkan t'a slum heb' chi', yujto te ay swael nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Hanhejtona', ay pax 500-xo heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Simeón chi' ix k'och kajan t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Seir. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isi, haton winhaj Pelatías, winhaj Nearías, winhaj Refaías yet' winhaj Uziel ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha heb' ix satanel heb' amalecita aytoek' ta'. Haxo heb' ix kajnajkan ta'.

Ha winhaj Rubén, winh sb'ab'el unin winhaj Jacob, palta maj scha chab' makan smakb'en winh yik sb'ab'el uninal chi', yujto ix way winh yet' ix schab'il yetb'eyum smam. Yuj chi' a junxo makan smakb'en winh chi', ix ak'chajkan t'a heb' winh yuninal winhaj José, haton junxo yuninal winhaj Jacob chi'.

Wach'chom ha t'a winhaj José chi' ix ak'chajkan jun makb'en yik b'ab'el uninab'il chi', palta a winhaj Judá te niwan ix aj yelk'och t'a skal heb' yuk'tak chi', yuj chi' ha t'a yinhtilal winh ix kot heb' ix ak'an yajalil t'a Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Rubén chi': Haton winhaj Hanoc, winhaj Falú, winhaj Hezrón yet' winhaj Carmi.

Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Joel t'a stzolal: Winhaj Semaías, winhaj Gog, winhaj Simei, winhaj Micaías, winhaj Reaía, winhaj Baal yet' winhaj Beera. Ha winhaj Beera chi', yajal yaj winh t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', haton winh ik'jinakb'at preso yuj winhaj Tiglat-pileser sreyal Asiria.
Ha heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Beera chi', t'a stzolal ix aj stz'ib'chajkan heb' yet' yinhtilal. Haton winhaj Jeiel yajal yaji, winhaj Zacarías,

winhaj Bela yuninal winhaj Azaz, yixchikin winhaj Sema, yinhtilal winhaj Joel. Ha winhaj Bela chi' yet' yinhtilal winh, ix kajnaj heb' t'a Aroer, ix k'och smakb'en heb' chi' t'a Nebo yet' t'a Baal-meón.
Ix kajnaj pax heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u masanto t'a tzinan lu'um, haton lum sk'ochnhej t'a ha' Éufrates, yujto ix te q'uib' sb'isul nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a yol yik Galaad.

Ayik ayoch winhaj Saúl reyal, a heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', yak'nak owal heb' yet' heb' agarenos, yak'nak ganar heb' agareno chi' heb', haxo heb' kajnajnakkan t'a schonhab' heb' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a Galaad chi'.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Gad, ix kajnaj heb' t'a snorteal smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Rubén, t'a yol yik Basán, masanto t'a chonhab' Salca t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton sb'i heb' winh tik:
Ha winhaj Joel yajal t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok kajan t'a Basán chi', schab'il winhaj Safán.Ix kajnajpax winhaj Jaanai yet' winhaj Safat ta'.

Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, icha syal stzolal smam yicham heb' winh: Winhaj Micael, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Seba, winhaj Jorai, winhaj Jacán, winhaj Zía yet' winhaj Heber, ukwanh heb' winh t'a smasanil.

Ha heb' winh chi' yinhtilal winhaj Abihail yuninal winhaj Huri. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham heb' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Abihail, winhaj Huri, winhaj Jaroa, winhaj Galaad, winhaj Micael, winhaj Jesisai, winhaj Jahdo yet' winhaj Buz.
Yet' pax winhaj Ahí, yuninal winhaj Abdiel yixchikin winhaj Guni, yajal t'a skal heb' yinhtilal.
Ix kajnaj heb' smasanil t'a Galaad yet' t'a Basán yet' t'a yaldeail yet' t'a masanil b'aj wach' swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a Sarón, masanto t'a smojon heb'.
Masanil juntzanh heb' tik ix tz'ib'chaj yet' yinhtilal ayik ayoch winhaj Jotam reyal t'a Judá, haxo winhaj Jeroboam ayoch reyal t'a Israel.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Rubén chi', heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ay 44 mil 760 heb' soldado te tek'an, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb', yespada heb' yet' sjul-lab' heb', te k'ayb'ab'il heb' yak'an owal.
Ix yak'an owal heb' yet' heb' agareno yet' winhaj Jetur, winhaj Nafis yet' winhaj Nodab.
Ix yak'och Dios heb' yipok sk'ool, ix sk'anan skolwal Dios chi' heb'. Ix spakan tas ix sk'an heb', yuj chi' ix ak'jioch heb' agareno yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' israel chi'.
Yuj chi', haton tik ix yik'kan heb' t'a heb' agareno chi': 50 mil nok' camello, 250 mil nok' kalnel, 2 mil nok' b'uru yet' 100 mil anima ix yik'b'at heb' chekab'wumal.
Te niwan heb' ajk'ol chi' ix chami, yujto a jun owal chi' ha Dios ay yiko'. Icha chi' ix aj skajnajkan heb' yinhtilal Rubén t'a juntzanh lugar chi', masanto ix ik'chajb'at heb' t'a ch'ok nacional.
Haxo nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi', yujto te tzijtum sb'isul heb', ix kajnaj heb' t'a sat lum sb'atnhej t'a Basán masanto sk'och t'a Baal-hermón, skuchanpax lum Senir yet' lum switzal Hermón.

Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb': Haton winhaj Efer, winhaj Isi, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Azriel, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Hodabías yet' winhaj Jahdiel. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', soldado te tek'an, te jelan pax heb' winh, b'inajnak heb' winh, yajal heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.

Palta ix te och wal spitalil heb' winh t'a Dios, ix yaktejkan sDiosal smam yicham heb' winh, haxo t'a juntzanh sdiosal juntzanh chonhab' ix satel Dios t'a yichanh heb' chi', hata' ix och heb' ejmelal.

Yuj chi' ha Dios chi' ix chekankot winh sreyal Asiria, haton winhaj Pul, skuchan pax Tiglat-pileser. Ix jawi winh t'a slum heb' yinhtilal Rubén, heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi'. Ix ak'jioch heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, yuj chi' ix ik'jib'at heb' t'a chonhab' Halah, t'a Habor, t'a Hara yet' t'a stitak ha' Gozán. Hata' ix kannhej heb'.
Ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Leví: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo winhaj Coat chi' chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.

Ha winhaj Amram chi' chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés yet' jun yisil winh, haton ix María. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aarón chi' chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón tik sb'eyb'at t'a stzolal t'a heb' winh uninab'il yet' t'a heb' winh ichikinab'il: Winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Finees, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahimaas, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Azarías, (haton winh sacerdote yaj t'a templo ix sb'ok'e winhaj Salomón t'a Jerusalén), winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Salum, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Seraías yet' winhaj Josadac. Ha winhaj Josadac chi' ix ik'jib'at winh preso yet' heb' ay t'a Jerusalén yet' juntzanhxo lugar t'a yol yik Judá yuj winhaj rey Nabucodonosor, yujto a Jehová ix ak'an sk'ulej winh icha chi'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Leví oxwanh heb': Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Libni yet' winhaj Simei.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Coat chi': Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari chi': Haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Ha heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yinhtilal Leví heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Libni, winhaj Jahat, winhaj Zima, winhaj Joa, winhaj Iddo, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Jeatrai.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Aminadab, winhaj Coré, winhaj Asir, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Ebiasaf, winhaj Asir, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Uriel, winhaj Ozías yet' winhaj Saúl.

Haxo winhaj Elcana chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amasai yet' winhaj Ahimot. Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Ahimot chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Elcana, winhaj Safai, winhaj Nahat, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Elcana yet' winhaj Samuel.
Haxo winhaj Samuel chi' chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Vasni sb'ab'el yuninal winh, schab'il winhaj Abías.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari t'a stzolal: Winhaj Mahli, winhaj Libni, winhaj Simei, winhaj Uza, winhaj Simea, winhaj Haguía yet' winhaj Asaías.
Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix ak'jioch yuj winhaj rey David yik sb'itan heb' winh t'a skajnub' Jehová, yiktax ix ak'jioch te' skaxail trato t'a yol skajnub' Jehová t'a Jerusalén.
T'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' winh sb'itan t'a yichanh kajnub' chi' masanto yik ix b'ojik'e stemplo Jehová yuj winhaj Salomón.

Ha heb' winh ayoch t'a yopisio sb'itan chi' yet' heb' winh yuninal, haton sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hemán skuchb'an jun makan heb' winh sb'itan chi'. Ha sb'i heb' winh b'aj ix kot yinhtilal winhaj Hemán chi' tz'el yich t'a winh smam winh masanto t'a slajwub'xo smam yicham winh, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Joel, winhaj Samuel, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Toa, winhaj Zuf, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Mahat, winhaj Amasai, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Joel, winhaj Azarías, winhaj Sofonías, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Asir, winhaj Ebiasaf, winhaj Coré, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Coat, winhaj Leví yet' winhaj Israel.

Ha t'a swach' winhaj Hemán chi' skan winhaj Asaf, haton winh skuchb'an junxo makan heb' winh sb'itan chi'. Haton sb'i heb' winh smam yicham winhaj Asaf chi' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Berequías, winhaj Simea, winhaj Micael, winhaj Baasías, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Etni, winhaj Zera, winhaj Adaía, winhaj Etán, winhaj Zima, winhaj Simei, winhaj Jahat, winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Leví.

Haxo t'a sk'exanh winhaj Hemán chi' skan heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari sb'itan paxi. Ha winhaj Etán skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi'. Haton stzolal smam yicham winhaj Etán tik: Winhaj Quisi, winhaj Abdi, winhaj Maluc, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Hilcías, winhaj Amsi, winhaj Bani, winhaj Semer, winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi, winhaj Merari yet' winhaj Leví.
Haxo juntzanh heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, hanheja' yinhtilal Leví heb' winh, ix kan heb' winh munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová.

Ha winhaj Aarón yet' heb' yinhtilal, a heb' snhusan ofrenda t'a altar b'aj stz'a silab' yet' t'a altar yik incienso. Hanhejtona' a heb' tz'ilan masanil opisio t'a jun Lugar Yiknhej Jehová yaji yet' yik tz'ak'ji tup smul heb' yetisraelal heb', icha wal yutejnak winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios yalankani.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Eleazar, winhaj Finees, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Buqui, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Zeraías, winhaj Meraiot, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Ahitob, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Ahimaas.

Haton juntzanh chonhab' tik yet' smakb'en b'aj ix kajnaj heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Ix och suerte t'a yib'anh heb' winh. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat ix em jun b'ab'el makan, yuj chi' a chonhab' Hebrón t'a yol yik Judá, a ix kan t'a heb' winh yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' winh. Palta a juntzanh yaldeail yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak chi' ak'b'il t'a winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi' ix ak'chaj Hebrón, haton jun chonhab' chi' b'aj syal skolan sb'a heb' smilancham junok anima manh sk'anok sk'ool. Ix ak'jipax juntzanhxo chonhab' tik t'a heb': Libna, Jatir, Estemoa, Hilén, Debir, Asán yet' Bet-semes. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ha t'a yol yik Judá ay. Haxo t'a yol yik Benjamín ix ak'chaj juntzanhxo chonhab' tik: Geba, Alemet yet' Anatot. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', 13 t'a smasanil, ix kannhej yet' sluumal t'a spatiktak b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Yet' t'a smakb'en yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix ak'chajpax lajunhexo chonhab' t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat chi'.

Haxo pax t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, icha jay makan yaj heb', 13 chonhab' ix ak'chaj t'a heb'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yik Aser, heb' yik Neftalí yet' t'a yik heb' Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, haton t'a Basán.

Hanheja' pax t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, ix ak'chaj 12 chonhab' icha jay makan yaj heb'. Ha juntzanh chonhab' chi', ha t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Rubén ay, heb' yik Gad yet' heb' yik Zabulón.
Ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' chi' t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví yuj heb' yetisraelal yet' pax b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' t'a spatiktak juntzanh chonhab' chi'.
Ha t'a smakb'en Judá, yik Simeón yet' yik Benjamín, hata' ay juntzanh chonhab' toxo ix b'inaj ix ak'chaj t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví chi', icha ix aj yik'an heb' t'a suerteal.
Ay juntzanhxo makan yinhtilal winhaj Coat ix chaan juntzanh chonhab' b'aj tz'aj heb' t'a smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Efraín:
Haton Siquem t'a tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Efraín chi', haton t'a jun chonhab' chi' syal skolan sb'a heb' smilancham junok anima to manh sk'anok sk'ool. Ix yik'anpax juntzanh chonhab' tik heb': Gezer,
Jocmeam, Bet-horón, Ajalón yet' Gat-rimón. Masanil juntzanh chi' ix yik' heb' yet' b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Yet' t'a smakb'en yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix schapax chonhab' Aner yet' Bileam heb' yet' pax b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, icha syal jay makan yaj heb', ix ak'chaj chonhab' Golán t'a yol yik Basán, chonhab' Astarot yet' b'aj syal swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'. Ha chab' chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en Manasés t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u.
Ix ak'chajpax juntzanhxo chonhab' tik t'a heb' t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Isacar: Cedes, Daberat, Ramot yet' Anem. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ix ak'chajpax juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a heb' t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Aser: Masal, Abdón, Hucoc yet' Rehob. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol smakb'en heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Cedes t'a yol yik Galilea, Hamón yet' Quiriataim. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' t'a heb' t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Zabulón: Rimón yet' Tabor. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Rubén t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u t'a ha' Jordán, t'a yichanhb'at Jericó, ix ak'chaj juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Beser t'a jun ak'lik tzinan lu'um, Jaza, Cademot yet' Mefaat. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Haxo t'a yol yik heb' yinhtilal Gad, ix ak'chajpax juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a heb': Ramot t'a yol yik Galaad, Mahanaim, Hesbón yet' Jazer. Ha t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi', aynhej b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isacar chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Tola, winhaj Fúa, winhaj Jasub yet' winhaj Simrón.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Tola chi': Haton winhaj Uzi, winhaj Refaías, winhaj Jeriel, winhaj Jahmai, winhaj Jibsam yet' winhaj Semuel. Haton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal. Ha t'a stiempoal winhaj rey David, 22 mil 600 sb'isul heb' soldado te jelan t'a owal t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Tola chi'.

Ha winhaj Uzi chi' ay jun yuninal winh, haton winhaj Israhías. Ha winhaj Israhías chi' ay chanhwanh yuninal winh: Winhaj Micael, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Isías. Ha winh yet' heb' winh yuninal chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal.
Yujto tzijtum heb' ix yetb'eyum heb' winh yet' yal yuninal junjun heb' winh, yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh, ay 36 mil sb'isul heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a owal.
Ha sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado yinhtilal heb' chanhwanh yuninal winhaj Isacar chi' te jelan t'a owal, ay 87 mil heb'.
Oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winhaj Benjamín: Haton winhaj Bela, winhaj Bequer yet' winhaj Jediael.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bela chi', owanh heb' winh: Winhaj Ezbón, winhaj Uzi, winhaj Uziel, winhaj Jerimot yet' winhaj Iri. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal. Haxo sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh, ay 22 mil 34 heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bequer: Haton winhaj Zemira, winhaj Joás, winhaj Eliezer, winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Omri, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Abías, winhaj Anatot yet' winhaj Alemet.
Ha sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh, ay 20 mil 200 heb'.

Ha winhaj Jediael ay jun yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Bilhán. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bilhán chi': Haton winhaj Jeús, winhaj Benjamín, winhaj Aod, winhaj Quenaana, winhaj Zetán, winhaj Tarsis yet' winhaj Ahisahar.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal. Haxo sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', ay 17 mil 200 heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ir, haton winhaj Supim yet' winhaj Hupim. Haxo yuninal winhaj Aher, haton winhaj Husim.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Neftalí: Haton winhaj Jahzeel, winhaj Guni, winhaj Jezer yet' winhaj Salum. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal winhaj Jacob yet' ix Bilha.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Manasés yet' ix aj Siria schab'il yetb'eyum: Haton winhaj Asriel yet' winhaj Maquir, smam winhaj Galaad.

Ha winhaj Maquir chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Maaca, yinhtilal winhaj Hupim yet' winhaj Supim. Ay jun yuninal winhaj Maquir chi', haton winhaj Zelofehad. Ha jun winh chi', anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay.

Haxo ix Maaca yetb'eyum winhaj Maquir chi', ix alji chawanh swinak unin ix. Peres ix yak' ix sb'iej jun, haxo junxo Seres. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Peres chi', Ulam sb'i winh b'ab'el, Requem sb'i junxo winh.
Haxo jun yuninal winhaj Ulam chi', haton winhaj Bedán. Ha heb' winh tik a winhaj Galaad yuninal winhaj Maquir ay yinhtilal heb' winh, haton winh yixchikin winhaj Manasés.
Ha jun ix yanab' winhaj Maquir chi': Haton ix Hamolequet, haton ix snun winhaj Isod, winhaj Abiezer yet' winhaj Mahala.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semida: Haton winhaj Ahián, winhaj Siquem, winhaj Likhi yet' winhaj Aniam.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Efraín sb'eynhejkot t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Sutela, winhaj Bered, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Elada, winhaj Tahat, winhaj Zabad, winhaj Sutela. Ay chawanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Efraín chi', haton winhaj Ezer yet' winhaj Elad, milb'ilcham heb' winh yuj heb' kajan t'a Gat, yujto ix emk'och heb' yelk'ej nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb' kajan t'a Gat chi'.
Ha winhaj Efraín smam heb' winh chi', tzijtum k'ual ix te kus winh. Ix jawi heb' sk'ab'yok winh yak' sniwanil sk'ool.
Ixlajwi chi' ix alji pax junxo yuninal winhaj Efraín chi' yet' ix yetb'eyum, Bería ix yak' winh sb'iej, yujto ix ek' jun niwan kusk'olal chi' t'a heb'.
Ha ix Seera yisil winhaj Bería chi', a ix ix b'oank'e chonhab' Bet-horón jun ay t'a yalanh yet' Bet-horón ay t'a yib'anh yet' chonhab' Uzen-seera.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Bería sb'eynhejkot t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Refa, winhaj Resef, winhaj Telah, winhaj Tahán, winhaj Laadán, winhaj Amiud, winhaj Elisama, winhaj Nun, winhaj Josué.

Haxo sluum heb' winh b'aj kajan: Haton Betel yet' Naarán t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, Gezer t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' Siquem masanto sk'och t'a Ayah. Ix scha juntzanh chonhab' chi' heb' winh yet' yaldeail.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés, ix kajnaj heb' winh t'a chonhab' Bet-seán, Taanac, Meguido, Dor yet' yaldeail juntzanh chonhab' chi'. Haton t'a juntzanh chonhab' chi' ix kajnaj heb' yinhtilal José, yuninalkan winhaj Israel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aser: Haton winhaj Imna, winhaj Isúa, winhaj Isúi, winhaj Bería yet' ix Sera yanab' heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bería chi': Haton winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Malquiel smam winhaj Birzavit.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Heber chi': Haton winhaj Jaflet, winhaj Semer, winhaj Hotam yet' ix Súa yanab' heb' winh.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaflet chi': Haton winhaj Pasac, winhaj Bimhal yet' winhaj Asvat.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semer chi': Haton winhaj Ahí, winhaj Rohga, winhaj Jehúba yet' winhaj Aram.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Helem: Haton winhaj Sofa, winhaj Imna, winhaj Seles yet' winhaj Amal.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Sofa chi': Haton winhaj Súa, winhaj Harnefer, winhaj Súal, winhaj Beri, winhaj Imra,
winhaj Beser, winhaj Hod, winhaj Sama, winhaj Silsa, winhaj Itrán yet' winhaj Beera.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeter: Haton winhaj Jefone, winhaj Pispa yet' winhaj Ara.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ula: Haton winhaj Ara, winhaj Haniel yet' winhaj Rezia.

Masanil juntzanh heb' winh tik yinhtilal Aser heb' winh. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal, te niwak pax yelk'och heb' winh. Ha sb'isul heb' soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Aser chi', ay 26 mil heb'.
Ha winhaj Benjamín owanh yuninal winh: Haton sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Bela, winh b'ab'el, winhaj Asbel, winhaj Ahara, winhaj Noha yet' winhaj Rafa.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Bela chi': Haton winhaj Adar, winhaj Gera, winhaj Abiud, winhaj Abisúa, winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ahoa, winhaj Gera, winhaj Sefufán yet' winhaj Hiram.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Aod: Haton winhaj Naamán, winhaj Ahías yet' winhaj Gera. Ha heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok kajan t'a Geba, palta ik'jinakel heb' t'a Geba chi', ik'chajnakb'at kajan heb' t'a Manahat yuj winhaj Gera smam winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahiud.
Ha winhaj Saharaim ayto juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji ayik ayek' winh t'a Moab, ayik toxo ix spuklaj sb'a winh yet' heb' ix yetb'eyum, haton ix Husim yet' ix Baara.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' junxo ix yetb'eyum skuchan Hodes: Haton winhaj Jobab, winhaj Sibia, winhaj Mesa, winhaj Malcam,
winhaj Jeúz, winhaj Saquías yet' winhaj Mirma. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ay chawanh yuninal winh yet' ix yetb'eyum skuchan Husim chi', haton winhaj Abitob yet' winhaj Elpaal.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elpaal chi': Haton winhaj Heber, winhaj Misam yet' winhaj Semed. Ha winhaj Semed chi' b'oannakk'e chonhab' Ono, chonhab' Lod yet' yaldeail.
Ha winhaj Bería yet' winhaj Sema, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' kajan t'a Ajalón, pechjinakel heb' kajan t'a Gat yuj heb' winh.
Ha heb' yinhtilal winhaj Bería chi': Haton winhaj Ahío, winhaj Sasac yet' winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Arad, winhaj Ader, winhaj Micael, winhaj Ispa yet' winhaj Joha.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Elpaal: Haton winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Hizqui, winhaj Heber, winhaj Ismerai, winhaj Jezlías yet' winhaj Jobab.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei: Haton winhaj Jaquim, winhaj Zicri, winhaj Zabdi, winhaj Elienai, winhaj Ziletai, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Adaías, winhaj Beraías yet' winhaj Simrat.

Eb' winh yuninal winhaj Sasac: Haton winhaj Ispan, winhaj Heber, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Abdón, winhaj Zicri, winhaj Hanán, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Elam, winhaj Anatotías, winhaj Ifdaías yet' winhaj Peniel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Jeroham: Haton winhaj Samserai, winhaj Seharías, winhaj Atalías, winhaj Jaresías, winhaj Elías yet' winhaj Zicri.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun makan yinhtilal ix kajnaj t'a Jerusalén.
Ha t'a chonhab' Gabaón ek'nak winhaj Jehiel smam yicham heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Maaca sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Abdón winh b'ab'el, winhaj Zur, winhaj Cis, winhaj Baal, winhaj Ner, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Gedor, winhaj Ahío, winhaj Zequer yet' winhaj Miclot, smam winhaj Simea. Hanhejtona' juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kajnajpax heb' winh yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok t'a Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Ner chi' smam winhaj Cis, haxo winhaj Cis smam winhaj Saúl. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi': Haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Malquisúa, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Es-baal.
Ay jun yuninal winhaj Jonatán chi', haton winhaj Merib-baal, smam winhaj Micaía.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Micaía chi': Haton winhaj Pitón, winhaj Melec, winhaj Tarea yet' winhaj Acaz.
Haxo winhaj Acaz chi' smam winhaj Joada, haxo winhaj Joada chi' smam winhaj Alemet, winhaj Azmavet yet' winhaj Zimri. Haxo winhaj Zimri chi' smam winhaj Mosa.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Mosa chi' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Bina, winhaj Rafa, winhaj Elasa, winhaj Azel.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Azel wakwanh heb' winh: Winhaj Azricam, winhaj Bocru, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Searías, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Hanán.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Esec yuk'tak winhaj Azel: Haton winhaj Ulam winh b'ab'el unin, schab'il winhaj Jehús, yoxil winhaj Elifelet.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Ulam chi', te tek'an heb' winh yak'an owal, yojtak wal heb' winh sjulwaji. Tzijtum yuninal heb' winh yet' yixchikin, 150 sb'isul heb' winh t'a smasanil. Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', a winhaj Benjamín ay yinhtilal heb' winh.
Icha tik ix aj stz'ib'chajkan masanil heb' israel t'a stzolal tas yaj yinhtilal heb' b'aj aykan yab'ixal heb' sreyal Israel. Ha heb' anima ay t'a Judá, ik'chajnakb'at heb' t'a Babilonia yuj schukal.
Ha heb' yinhtilal Israel b'ab'laj meltzajxikot t'a sluum yet' t'a schonhab', haton heb' sacerdote, heb' levita yet' heb' smunlaj t'a templo.
Ha t'a Jerusalén ix kan kajan heb' yinhtilal Judá, heb' yik Benjamín, heb' yik Efraín yet' heb' yik Manasés.

Ha t'a yinhtilal Judá chi', ay 690 heb' winh winak t'a smasanil. Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá, a winhaj Utai yuninal winhaj Amihud yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' smam yicham t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Omri, winhaj Imri, winhaj Bani yet' winhaj Fares yuninal winhaj Judá chi'. Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sela yuninal winhaj Judá chi', a winhaj Asaías winh b'ab'el unin, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' sk'ab'yok. Haxo t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Zera, yuninal pax winhaj Judá chi', a winhaj Jeuel yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.

Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín tik: Winhaj Salú yuninal winhaj Mesulam yixchikin winhaj Hodabías, yinhtilal winhaj Asenúa, winhaj Ibneías yuninal winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Ela yixchikin winhaj Uzi, yinhtilal winhaj Micri, winhaj Mesulam yuninal winhaj Sefatías, yixchikin winhaj Reuel, yinhtilal winhaj Ibnías. 956 heb' t'a smasanil.

Haxo heb' winh sacerdote kajan t'a Jerusalén yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok: Haton winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jaquín yet' winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Hilcías. Ha heb' smam yicham winhaj Azarías t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Meraiot yet' winhaj Ahitob. Ha winhaj Azarías chi' yajal t'a stemplo Dios. Hanheja' t'a skal heb' winh yajal yaj chi', ayoch winhaj Adaías yuninal winhaj Jeroham. Ha sb'i heb' smam yicham winhaj Adaías chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Pasur, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Masai, winhaj Adiel, winhaj Jahzera, winhaj Mesulam, winhaj Mesilemit yet' winhaj Imer. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha t'a skal heb', ay mil 760 heb' winh te nhikan smunlaj t'a skajnub' Dios.
Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' levita kajan t'a Jerusalén: Haton winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Hasub, yixchikin winhaj Azricam, schab'il yixchikin winhaj Hasabías, yinhtilal winhaj Merari.
Yajal pax winhaj Bacbacar, winhaj Heres, winhaj Galal yet' winhaj Matanías yuninal winhaj Micaía, yixchikin winhaj Zicri, yinhtilal winhaj Asaf.

Yajal pax yaj winhaj Obadías yuninal winhaj Semaías, yixchikin winhaj Galal, yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Berequías, yuninal winhaj Asa, yixchikin winhaj Elcana ek'nak kajan t'a juntzanh aldea yik heb' netofatita.
Haxo heb' winh stanhwan puerta: Haton winhaj Salum, winhaj Acub, winhaj Talmón, winhaj Ahimán yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh. Ha winhaj Salum yajal yaj t'a heb' winh.
Ha heb' winh tik stanhwannhej puerta yik heb' winh rey t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Haton heb' winh stanhwan puerta chi' t'a skal heb' yetlevitail.

Ha winhaj Salum yuninal winhaj Coré, yixchikin winhaj Ebiasaf, yinhtilal winhaj Coré yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, a heb' stanhwan skajnub' Dios, icha ajnak stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios chi' heb' smam yicham heb' t'a peka'.
Ha t'a peka' chi', a winhaj Finees yuninal winhaj Eleazar ayoch yajalilok heb' stanhwan skajnub' Dios chi'. Aynhej wal och Jehová yet' winh.
Haxo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Meselemías, a winh stanhwan spuertail b'aj sch'ox sb'a Dios.

Ha sb'isul heb' stanhwan spuertail kajnub' sik'b'ilel chi', 212 heb' tz'ib'ab'ilkani icha tas yinhtilal junjun makan b'aj kajan heb'. Ha winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios ak'jinakkanoch heb' t'a yopisio niwan yelk'och chi'.
Masanil heb' yet' pax yuninal heb', ayoch heb' t'a stzolal stanhwan spuertail skajnub' Dios.
Aynhejoch stanhwumal chi' t'a schanhil pak'anh: T'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, t'a stojolal norte yet' t'a stojolal sur.
Ha heb' yetlevitail heb' kajan t'a juntzanhxo aldea, t'a junjun yuktakil k'ual sjawi heb' stanhwej templo chi', yik skolwaj heb' yet' heb'.
Ay chanhwanh heb' levita niwak yopisio stanhwan puerta chi'. Ha heb' chi' ayoch heb' t'a masanil tiempo stanhwan juntzanh cuarto yet' b'aj smolchaj tas tz'ak'ji t'a skajnub' Dios chi'.
Ha heb' chi' aynhejek' heb' t'a spatiktak kajnub' chi' tzek' ak'wal, yujto a heb' stanhwani. Haxo t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil sjakan kajnub' chi' heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' t'a skal heb' chi' stanhwan juntzanh yamk'ab' sk'anchaji yik tz'och ejmelal t'a Dios. Yowalil sb'is heb' jantak tz'elta, slajwi chi' sb'isan heb' yochxikani.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' tz'ilan juntzanhxo yamk'ab' niwak yelk'ochi yet' pax ixim harina, wino, aceite, incienso yet' perfume.
Ay pax heb' sacerdote sb'oan perfume chi'.
Haxo jun winh levita skuchan Matatías, b'ab'el yuninal winhaj Salum, yinhtilal winhaj Coré, a winh sb'oan ixim pan tz'ak'ji ofrendail.
Haxo juntzanhxo heb' winh yetlevitail heb' winh, heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, a heb' winh sb'oan ixim pan tz'em tzolan t'a sat mexa t'a yol skajnub' Dios t'a junjun k'ual ik'oj ip.

Hanhejtona' ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a yinhtilal heb' winh levita chi' sb'itani. Ha t'a juntzanh cuarto yik templo chi' ay heb' winh, malaj yalan yik heb' winh t'a juntzanhxo munlajel, yujto k'ual t'ak'wal yajoch heb' winh t'a yopisio chi'.
Ha heb' winh ix b'inaj tik, yajal yaj heb' winh t'a skal masanil heb' yinhtilal Leví chi', icha yaj stzolal yinhtilal heb' winh. Ha t'a Jerusalén kajan heb' winh.
Ha t'a chonhab' Gabaón, hata' ek'nak kajan winhaj Jehiel, smam yicham heb' aj Gabaón chi'. Maaca sb'i ix yetb'eyum winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Abdón winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Zur, winhaj Cis, winhaj Baal, winhaj Ner, winhaj Nadab, winhaj Gedor, winhaj Ahío, winhaj Zacarías yet' winhaj Miclot.
Ha winhaj Miclot chi' smam winhaj Simeam. Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kajnaj heb' winh yet' heb' sk'ab'yok t'a Jerusalén.
Ha winhaj Ner smam winhaj Cis, haxo winhaj Cis chi' smam winhaj Saúl. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Saúl chi': Haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Malquisúa, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Es-baal.
Ha winhaj Jonatán chi' smam winhaj Merib-baal smam winhaj Micaía.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Micaía chi': Haton winhaj Pitón, winhaj Melec, winhaj Tarea yet' winhaj Acaz.

Haxo winhaj Acaz smam winhaj Jara. Haxo winhaj Jara chi' smam winhaj Alemet, winhaj Azmavet yet' winhaj Zimri. Haxo winhaj Zimri chi' smam winhaj Mosa. Haxo winhaj Mosa chi' smam winhaj Bina. Haxo winhaj Bina chi' smam winhaj Refaías, winhaj Elasa yet' winhaj Azel.
Eb' yuninal winhaj Azel chi', wakwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Azricam, winhaj Bocru, winhaj Ismael, winhaj Searías, winhaj Obadías yet' winhaj Hanán.
Ix yak' owal heb' filisteo yet' heb' israel, ix el lemnaj heb' israel chi', te niwan heb' ix cham t'a lum witzal Gilboa.
Ix b'at heb' filisteo chi' t'a spatik winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal: Haton winhaj Jonatán, winhaj Abinadab yet' winhaj Malquisúa. Ix miljicham heb' winh yuninal winh chi' yoxwanhil.
Ix ochwal heb' winh filisteo chi' t'a spatik winhaj Saúl chi', ix lajwi winh sjulan heb' winh.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh t'a winh et'jinak syamk'ab' icha tik: Ik'k'eta k'een espada chi', tza tipanoch k'een t'ayin, yik wach' manhok juntzanh ch'ok chonhab'il tik ol tzalaj in smilani, xchi winh. Palta a winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi', maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix sk'ulej icha ix yal winh chi', yujto xiw winh. Yuj chi' a winh ix ik'ank'eta k'een yespada, ix syumanb'at nhojnaj sb'a winh t'a yib'anh snhi' k'een.
Ayik ix yilan winh et'jinak syamk'ab' winh chi' to toxo ix cham winh, ix syumanpaxb'at nhojnaj sb'a winh t'a yib'anh snhi' k'een yespada chi', ix champax winh.
Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Saúl t'a jun k'u chi' yet' oxwanh heb' winh yuninal. Manhxo junok yinhtilal winh ix elkani.

Ayik ix yilan heb' israel kajan t'a jun ch'olan chi' to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' yetisraelal heb', toxo ix champax winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal, yuj chi' ix yaktejkan schonhab' heb', ix b'at heb' elelal. Haxo heb' filisteo ix k'ochkan kajan t'a juntzanh schonhab' heb' chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix b'at heb' filisteo chi' spojek' tastak ay t'a heb' ix cham chi'. Ix yilan heb' to a winhaj Saúl yet' heb' winh yuninal chamnakxo heb' winh, teljab'kan sniwanil heb' winh t'a lum witzal Gilboa.

Ha spichul winhaj Saúl chi' yik owal ayochi, elanhchamel ix yik'el heb', ix xikanel sjolom winh heb'. Ix yik'anb'at heb'. Ix schekan heb' b'at alchaj t'a masanil yol smakb'en heb' yet' t'a sdiosal heb'.
Ix b'at yak'anoch syamk'ab' winhaj Saúl chi' heb' t'a stemplo jun sdiosal skuchan Dagón, ix yak'ank'e lokan sjolom winh heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' aj Jabes ay t'a yol yik Galaad tas ix yutej sniwanil winhaj Saúl heb' filisteo chi',

ix slajtian sb'a masanil heb' winh winak te tek'an. Ix b'at yik'ankot sniwanil winhaj Saúl chi' heb' yet' pax sniwanil heb' winh yuninal winh, ix k'och yuj heb' t'a Jabes chi'. Ha t'a yich jun te' ji ix smuk sniwanil heb' winh chi' heb'. Uke' k'ual ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal yuj kusk'olal.

Icha chi' ix aj scham winhaj Saúl yuj chukal ix sk'ulej, yujto maj sk'anab'ajej scheknab'il Jehová winh, yujto ix sk'anb'ej pax sb'a winh t'a jun ix sk'uman spixan heb' chamnak, manhok t'a Jehová ix sk'anb'ej sb'a winh.
Yuj chi' ix cham winh yuj Jehová, haxo t'a winhaj David yuninal winhaj Isaí ix ak'jikan yopisio winh chi'.
Ix smolb'ej sb'a masanil heb' israel, ix b'at lolon heb' yet' winhaj David t'a Hebrón. Ix yalan heb' t'a winh icha tik: Ha onh tik, junnhej ko mam kicham het'ok.

Ha t'a yalanhtaxo wach'chom a winhaj Saúl ayoch reyal, palta a ach ix onh a kuchb'ej ayik ix kak'an owal. Hanhejtona', ix yal Jehová ko Diosal t'ayach to a ach ol onh a kuchb'ej, ol ach ochpaxkan ko reyalok, xchi heb' t'a winh.

Ayik ix k'och heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel lolonel yet' winh t'a Hebrón chi', ix sb'oan jun strato winh yet' heb' t'a yichanh Jehová. Hata' ix ak'jik'e aceite t'a sjolom winh yik tz'ochkan winh sreyalok Israel, icha wal tas scheknak Jehová yal winhaj Samuel.
Ixlajwi chi', ix b'at winhaj rey David chi' yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal t'a Jerusalén, skuchan pax Jebús, b'aj kajan heb' jebuseo.

Ix yalan heb' jebuseo chi' t'a winh icha tik: Ha ach tik, manh ol yal-laj ochta t'a tik, xchi heb' t'a winh. Palta ix ak'ji ganar scuartel heb' t'a tzalan Sion chi' yuj winh, yuj chi' ix skuchkan schonhab' winhaj David.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha mach ol b'ab'lajoch yak' owal yet' heb' jebuseo tik, ol wak'och yajalilok heb' soldado, xchi winh. Haxo winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia ix b'ab'laji, yuj chi' ix och winh yajalilok heb' soldado chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix kajnaj winhaj rey David t'a cuartel t'a Sion chi', yuj chi' Schonhab' Winhaj David ix sb'iejkani.
Ix sb'ok'e juntzanhxo pat winh t'a spatiktak chi', ix schab'at t'a ch'olan masanto ix k'och t'a smuroal chonhab'. Haxo winhaj Joab ix wach' b'oan stz'akub' chonhab' Jebús chi'.
Ix yik'an stek'anil yopisio winhaj rey David chi', yujto a Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil aynhejoch yet' winh.

Ha heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David te b'inajnak, ix och heb' winh yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal ayik ix yak'anoch winhaj David chi' heb' reyal t'a yol smakb'en Israel smasanil. Ix te och wal heb' winh yet' winh yik syak'an reyal winh icha wal ix aj yalan Jehová.

Haton slistail heb' winh soldado winhaj rey David te b'inajnak chi': Ha winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Hacmoni, sat yaj winh t'a skal oxwanhxo heb' winh yetb'inajnakil chi'. Ha t'a junel ix smilcham 300 heb' winh winak winh yet' k'een slanza.
Haxo junxo winh t'a skal heb' winh oxwanh chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yuninal winhaj Dodo, yinhtilal winhaj Aho.

Ha t'a junel ayek' winh yet' winhaj rey David t'a Pas-damim ayik ix smolb'an sb'a heb' filisteo yak' owal ta'. Hata' ay jun munlajel b'aj awab'il ixim cebada. Ayik ix el lemnaj heb' soldado Israel t'a yichanh heb' filisteo,

haxo heb' winh chawanh chi' ix kan tek'naj t'a skal jun munlajel chi', yik syak'an owal heb' winh. Ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo chi' yuj heb' winh. Icha chi' ix aj skolchajkan chonhab' Israel yuj Jehová.

Ha t'a junel, a oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix b'at heb' winh t'a sattak k'een yik b'at schalan sb'a heb' winh yet' winhaj rey David t'a jun k'een nhak'een skuchan Adulam. Haxo heb' filisteo ay scampamento heb' t'a sch'olanil Refaim.
Ayik ayek' winhaj David t'a k'een nhak'een chi', ayek' scampamento heb' filisteo t'a Belén.
Yujto ste takji sti' winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Komonok a ha ha' ay t'a stiel chonhab' Belén swuk'ej, xchi winh.

Haxo oxwanh heb' winh soldado te b'inajnak chi', ix och heb' winh t'a scampamento heb' filisteo, ix b'at yik'anelta ha ha' heb' winh t'a ha' uk'b'ila' t'a stiel chonhab' Belén chi', ix yik'ankot ha' heb' winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Palta maj yal-laj sk'ol winh ix yuk'ej ha', tonhej ix sekem ha' winh t'a sat lu'um silab'il t'a Jehová.

Ix yalan winh icha tik: Mokab' scha Dios wuk' ha ha' tik. Ichato ha' schiq'uil heb' winh tik swuk'ej tato swuk' ha', yujto ix sb'ek sb'a heb' winh schami yik ix b'at yik'ankot ha' heb' winh, xchi winh. Yuj chi' maj yuk'ejlaj ha' winh. Haton jun tik ix sk'ulej heb' winh oxwanh te b'inajnak chi'.

Ha winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winhaj Joab, yajal yaj winh t'a 30-xo heb' winh te b'inajnak. Ha t'a jun pekti', ix smilcham 300 winak winh yet' k'een slanza. Icha wal chi' ix aj yik'an sb'inajnakil winh t'a skal heb' winh 30 chi'.
Yuj chi' te niwan ix aj yelk'och winh t'a yichanh heb' winh chi'. Ix och winh yajalok heb' winh, palta maj k'ek'och winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el chi'.

Ha winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada aj chonhab' Cabseel, te b'inajnak pax winh, tzijtum tas ix sk'ulej winh. Ha winh ix milancham chawanh soldado yuninal winhaj Ariel aj Moab. Haxo t'a junel ayik te ay k'een sakb'akom, ix em winh t'a yol jun jul. Hata' ix smilcham jun nok' choj winh.

Hanhejtona' ix smilcham jun winh aj Egipto winh. Nanhal am yoxil metro steel winh aj Egipto chi', haxo steal k'een slanza winh yet'nak, niwan spatik. Palta a winhaj Benaía chi' anhej jun te te' yet'nak winh. Ix yik'ek' k'een slanza winh aj Egipto chi' winh, haxo yet' k'een slanza winh chi', ix smilcham winh.
Ha yuj juntzanh tas ix sk'ulej winh chi' ix yik' wal sb'inajnakil winh icha heb' winh oxwanh b'ab'el b'inajnak chi'.
Niwan ix aj sb'inaj winh t'a yichanh heb' winh 30 chi', palta maj k'ochlaj icha heb' winh oxwanh chi'. Ix ak'jioch winhaj Benaía chi' yuj winhaj rey David yajalilok heb' stanhwumal.
Ha heb' winh 30 b'inajnak chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab, winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Dodo aj Belén,
winhaj Samot aj Harod, winhaj Heles aj Pelón,
winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa, winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot,
winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, winhaj Ilai aj Aho,
winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, winhaj Heled yuninal winhaj Baana aj Netofa paxi,
winhaj Itai yuninal winhaj Ribai aj Gabaa ay t'a yol yik Benjamín, winhaj Benaía aj Piratón,
winhaj Hurai kajan t'a sti' ha' Gaas, winhaj Abiel aj Arba,
winhaj Azmavet aj Bahurim, winhaj Eliaba aj Saalbón,
heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jasén aj Gizón, winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Sage aj Harar,
winhaj Ahíam yuninal winhaj Sacar aj Harar paxi, winhaj Elifal yuninal winhaj Ur,
winhaj Hefer aj Mequera, winhaj Ahías aj Pelón,
winhaj Hezro aj Carmel, winhaj Naarai yuninal winhaj Ezbai,
winhaj Joel yuk'tak winhaj Natán, winhaj Mibhar yuninal winhaj Hagrai,
winhaj Selec aj Amón, winhaj Naharai aj Berot. Ha jun winh chi' et'jinak syamk'ab' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia,
winhaj Ira aj Itra, winhaj Gareb aj Itra paxi,
winhaj Urías hitita, winhaj Zabad yuninal winhaj Ahlai,
winhaj Adina yuninal winhaj Siza, yinhtilal Rubén, yajal yaj winh t'a skal heb' yinhtilal chi', 30 heb' winh winak ajun yet' winh,
winhaj Hanán yuninal winhaj Maaca, winhaj Josafat aj Mitán,
winhaj Uzías aj Astarot, winhaj Sama yet' winhaj Jehiel, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hotam aj Aroer,
winhaj Jediael yuninal winhaj Simri yet' winhaj Joha yuk'tak winh, aj Tiza heb' winh,
winhaj Eliel aj Mahab, winhaj Jerebai yet' winhaj Josavía. Ha heb' winh tik yuninal heb' winh winhaj Elnaam, winhaj Itma aj Moab,
winhaj Eliel, winhaj Obed yet' winhaj Jaasiel, aj Soba heb' winh.
Ayik wan spechji b'eyek' winhaj David yuj winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis, ay jun nhilanh heb' winh jelan yak'an owal ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winh t'a Siclag.

Ha juntzanh heb' winh soldado chi' ay sjul-lab' heb' winh yet' ch'anh smejmeech yet'nak. Syal sjulwaj heb' winh t'a schab'il sk'ab'. Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi' ay heb' winh ayto yuj sb'a yet' winhaj Saúl t'a yinhtilal Benjamín. Haton heb' winh tik:

Ha winhaj Ahiezer sat yajal yaj winh yet' winhaj Joás yuk'tak winh, yuninal heb' winh winhaj Semaa aj chonhab' Gabaa, winhaj Jeziel yet' winhaj Pelet, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Azmavet, winhaj Beraca yet' winhaj Jehú aj chonhab' Anatot heb' winh,
winhaj Ismaías aj Gabaón. Ha jun winh tik ayoch winh stz'akub'ok heb' winh 30 b'inajnak, yajal yaj pax winh t'a heb' winh, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Jahaziel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Jozabad aj Gedera,
winhaj Eluzai, winhaj Jerimot, winhaj Bealías, winhaj Semarías, winhaj Sefatías aj chonhab' Haruf,
winhaj Elcana, winhaj Isías, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Joezer yet' winhaj Jasobeam, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Coré,
winhaj Joela yet' winhaj Zebadías heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jeroham aj chonhab' Gedor.

Ay pax juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad ix b'at yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ayek' winh t'a k'een nhak'een t'a tzinan lu'um. Ha juntzanh heb' winh chi' te jelan heb' winh, k'ayb'ab'il yuj heb' winh yak'an owal, yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab' heb' winh yet' k'een slanza. Te ow sat heb' winh icha nok' choj. Te jelan sb'ey heb' winh icha sb'ey nok' k'ultakil chej.

Ha sb'i heb' winh tik t'a stzolal, schael t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh yuxluchil: Winhaj Ezer, winhaj Obadías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Mismana, winhaj Jeremías, winhaj Atai, winhaj Eliel, winhaj Johanán, winhaj Elzabad, winhaj Jeremías yet' winhaj Macbanai.

Haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanh heb' winh yinhtilal Gad chi'. Ha junok winh kennhej yopisio t'a skal heb' winh, yajal winh t'a junok 100 soldado, haxo junok winh niwan yopisio, yajal yaj winh t'a junok mil soldado.

Haton heb' winh ix k'axpajek' t'a ha' Jordán t'a b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il, ayik ix te k'e ha', wan yel ha' t'a stitak b'aj sb'eyi. Ha heb' winh ix pechanel heb' anima kajan t'a ak'lik ay t'a sk'axepaltak ha'.
Hanhejtona' ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Benjamín yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Judá ix k'och yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David t'a k'een nhak'een chi'.

Ix elta winhaj David chi' scha heb' winh, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Tato t'a junk'olal tzex jawi, yik tzex kolwaj wet'ok, tzex in cha t'a smasanil in k'ool, palta tato tzex jawi yik tzin eyak'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' wajk'ol jun, wach'chom malaj junok tas chuk ix in k'ulej, aokab' ko Diosal, haton sDiosal heb' ko mam kicham ol yil sb'a heyet'ok, syak'anoch eyaelal, xchi winh t'a heb' winh.

Ix och Yespíritu Dios t'a winhaj Amasai yajalil heb' winh 30 soldado b'inajnak, yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Skak' wal och ko b'a het'ok ach David yuninal winhaj Isaí. Ha ach tik yet' heb' ayoch het'ok, wach'nhej ol aj eyelk'ochi, yujto a ko Diosal skolwaj wal het'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj David chi'. Yuj chi' ix chaji heb' winh yuj winhaj David chi', ix ak'ji yopisio heb' winh t'a skal heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado chi' yuj winh.

Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' winh soldado yinhtilal Manasés, ix och heb' winh yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ix b'at winh yet' heb' winh filisteo yak' owal yet' winhaj Saúl yalani. Haxo ix smolb'an sb'a heb' winh yajalil heb' filisteo chi', ix yalan heb' winh to max yal-laj sb'at winhaj David chi' yet' heb' winh, yuj chi' ix schek meltzaj winh heb' winh t'a Siclag. Yujto ix yal heb' winh icha tik: Haxo talaj tz'aji, a yet' winhaj Saúl syak'och sb'a winh, yujto yajal winhaj Saúl chi' winh, a onh xo tzonh smilcham winh t'a skal owal chi', xchi heb' winh.

Ayik wan sjaxkan winhaj David t'a Siclag chi', hata' ix k'och heb' winh yinhtilal Manasés chi' yik syak'och sb'a heb' yet' winh, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Adnas, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Jediaiel, winhaj Micael, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Eliú yet' winhaj Ziletai. Yajal yaj heb' winh t'a junjun mil soldado t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Manasés chi'.

Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik ix kolwaj yet' winhaj David chi' ayik ix yak'an owal winh yet' jun nhilanh heb' soldado elk'um yujto te jelan heb' smasanil t'a owal. Ix och heb' winh yajalilok heb' winh soldado winhaj David chi'.
Junjun k'u sq'uib' sb'isul heb' winh soldado ix yak'och sb'a yet' winhaj David chi'. Te niwan heb' winh, te ay pax smay heb' winh.

Ha sb'isul juntzanh soldado te jelan ix k'och t'a winhaj David t'a Hebrón yik tz'ak'jikanoch winh reyal sk'exulok heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl yuj heb' winh, icha ix aj yalan Jehová, haton heb' winh tik:
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, ay 6 mil 800 soldado yet'nak smaklab' jul-lab', yet'nak pax slanza heb' winh, lista yaj heb' winh yak'an owal.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, ay 7 mil 100 heb' winh soldado tek'an.
Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, ay 4 mil 600 heb' winh soldado.
Ay pax 3 mil 700 t'a yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, a winhaj Joiada ayoch yajalilok heb' winh.
Ha winhaj Sadoc kelem winh, te tek'an winh t'a owal. Ay 22 heb' sk'ab'yok winh, yajal yaj heb' winh, ajun heb' winh yet' winh.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, haton heb' sk'ab'yok winhaj Saúl, ay 3 mil heb' winh soldado ix k'och yet' winhaj David chi'. Ayik mantzak uji jun tik, ken manh masanilok heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, ay 20 mil 800 heb' winh soldado te tek'an, te b'inajnak heb' winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ay 18 mil heb' winak ix chekjikoti yik tz'ak'jikanoch winhaj David reyal.

Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, ix jawi 200 heb' winh yajal yet' pax masanil heb' winh soldado ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb' winh. Ha juntzanh heb' winh winak tik, snachaj wal el yuj heb' winh tas smoj sk'ulej chonhab' Israel.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, ay 50 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal, syalnhej sk'anan masanil yamk'ab' yik owal heb' winh, b'ekan sk'ool heb' winh skolwaj yet' winhaj David chi'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ay mil heb' winh yajal yaji yet' 37 mil heb' winh soldado yet'nak slanza yet' smaklab' jul-lab'.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, ay 28 mil 600 heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.
Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Aser, ay 40 mil heb' winh soldado smoj sb'at t'a owal.

Haxo t'a heb' ay t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán, ay 120 mil heb' winh soldado t'a yinhtilal Rubén, t'a yinhtilal Gad yet' pax t'a nanhalxo yinhtilal Manasés. Ha heb' winh chi' tz'akan yaj heb' winh yet' masanil syamk'ab' yik owal.

Ha masanil juntzanh heb' winh soldado tik, ix ja heb' winh t'a Hebrón ayik ix yak'ankanoch winhaj David heb' winh sreyalok chonhab' Israel. Hanhejtona' juntzanhxo heb' yetisraelal heb', junxonhej ix aj spensar heb' smasanil.
Oxe' k'ual ix ek' heb' yet' winhaj David chi' ta'. Ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb', yujto a heb' yetchonhab' heb' ix ak'an jantak tas ix swa heb' chi'.

Masanil heb' kajan t'a slak'aniltak chi' yet' heb' kajan t'a najat, icha heb' yinhtilal Isacar, heb' yinhtilal Zabulón yet' heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ix yik'kot wael heb' kuchb'il yuj nok' b'uru, nok' camello, nok' mula yet' pax nok' wakax. Tzijtum makanhil wael ix yik'kot heb', icha ixim harina, takinh higo, takinh uwa, wino, aceite, nok' wakax yet' nok' kalnel. Te niwan tas tz'ab'laj ix yik'kot heb', yujto manhxo jantakok tzalajk'olal t'a Israel chi'.
Ix lolon winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun nhilanh heb' winh soldado.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' yetisraelal icha tik: Ex wetisraelal, tato scha he k'ool, schaanpax sk'ol Jehová ko Diosal, skawtej heb' ketisraelal ay t'a yol ko makb'en tik, heb' aytokan t'a juntzanhxo lugar. Skawtej pax masanil heb' sacerdote yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita ayek' t'a schonhab' yet' t'a slum b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb',
yik wach' b'at kik'kot te' skaxail strato ko Diosal. Yujto atax t'a stiempoal winhaj Saúl ix b'atkan te' satk'olal kuuj, xchi winhaj David chi'.
Masanil heb' chonhab', ix cha sk'ol heb' to icha chi' tz'aji, yujto wach' jun pensar chi' ix yab' heb'.

Ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yetisraelal winhaj rey David t'a yol masanil smakb'en, skotnhej t'a ha' Sihor t'a smojonal Egipto, masanto b'aj tzonh k'och t'a chonhab' Amat, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxail strato Dios t'a Quiriat-jearim,
skuchanpax Baala t'a yol yik Judá. Ix b'at yik'kot te' skaxail strato Jehová Dios chi' heb' ta', haton Dios ay t'a yib'anh heb' querubín b'aj tz'ik'chajchaanh sb'i.
Ix yik'elta te' skaxail strato Dios chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Abinadab, ix yak'ank'e te' heb' t'a yib'anh jun te' ak' carreta. Haxo winhaj Uza yet' winhaj Ahío, ix kuchb'an b'ey te' carreta chi'.

Haxo winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' yetisraelal, ste tzalaj wal heb' t'a yichanh Dios. Yet' wal smasanil yip heb' sk'e cheneljok, sb'itan heb' yet' arpa, salterio, panderas, platillo yet' trompeta.
Palta ayik ix jawi heb' t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Quidón, a winhaj Uza chi' ix b'at yub'naj winh t'a te' skaxail trato chi', yujto ijan ix telwi nok' wakax tok'jinak te' carreta chi'.
Yuj chi' ix kot yowal Jehová t'a winh, ix chamkan winh ta' yuj, yujto ix b'at yub'naj winh t'a te' skaxail trato chi'.
Ix kot yowal winhaj rey David chi', yujto ix kot yowal sk'ol Jehová t'a winhaj Uza chi', ix cham winh yuj. Yuj chi' Pérez-uza ix sb'iejnhejkan jun lugar chi'.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' ix te xiw winhaj rey David t'a Dios, ix yalan winh icha tik: Tekan manhxo ol yal-laj wik'anb'at te' skaxail strato Dios b'aj kajan in, xchi winh.
Majxo yik'kot te' winh b'aj kajan chi', anhej to ix yal winh to skan te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom aj Gat.

Ha te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', oxe' ujal ix kan te' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'. Ix yak' wal swach'k'olal Jehová t'a yib'anh winh yet' yetb'eyum yet' yalyuninal yet' t'a yib'anh masanil tas ay t'a winh.

Ha winhaj Hiram sreyal Tiro, ix yak'kot schekab' winh t'a winhaj rey David. Ix yak'anpaxkot heb' albañil winh yet' heb' nhikum te', ix yik'ankot te' k'ute' heb' yik sb'ochaj spalacio winhaj rey David chi'.
Yuj chi' ix nachajel yuj winhaj rey David chi' to a Jehová ix ak'anoch winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel. Ix ik'jichaanh yopisio winh yuj Jehová yujto xajan chonhab' Israel yuj.
Ay juntzanhxo heb' ix yetb'eyum winhaj rey David ix yik' t'a Jerusalén, yuj chi' ayto yuninal winh yet' yisil ix alji yet' heb' ix.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winh ix alji t'a Jerusalén chi', haton winhaj Samúa, winhaj Sobab, winhaj Natán, winhaj Salomón,
winhaj Ibhar, winhaj Elisúa, winhaj Elpelet,
winhaj Noga, winhaj Nefeg, winhaj Jafía,
winhaj Elisama, winhaj Beeliada yet' winhaj Elifelet.

Ayik ix yab'an heb' filisteo to toxo ix och winhaj David sreyalok masanil heb' israel, ix och ijan heb' sayan tas tz'aj yak'an ganar, palta elanhchamel ix yab' winh, ix elta winh t'a yichanh heb' chi'.
Ix jawi heb' filisteo chi' yak' chukal t'a heb' anima kajan t'a sch'olanil Refaim.

Yuj chi' ix sk'anb'ej winhaj rey David t'a Dios icha tik: --¿Tzam yal wak'an owal yet' heb' filisteo tik? ¿Ol am ak'och heb' t'a yol in k'ab'? xchi winh. Ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh: --Ak' owal yet' heb', yujto ol wak'och heb' t'a yol a k'ab', xchi.

Yuj chi' ix k'e winhaj rey David b'aj ayek' heb' filisteo chi'. Hata' ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj winh. Ix yalan winh icha tik: Icha wal tz'aj sjakan sb'e junok ha' eluma', icha chi' ix aj sjakan b'e Jehová t'ayin t'a skal heb' wajk'ool, xchi winh. Yuj chi' Baal-perazim ix yak' winh sb'iej jun lugar chi'.
Ix yaktejkan juntzanh sdiosal heb' filisteo chi', yuj chi' ix schek winhaj rey David chi' nhusjoktz'aok.
Palta a heb' filisteo chi', ix jaxxi heb' t'a sch'olanil yik Refaim chi'.

Yuj chi', ix sk'anb'ejxi winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios, ix yalan Dios t'a winh icha tik: --Ha tiknaik, manh ach och t'a sat heb' ak'an owal, palta to ha t'a spatik heb' tzach koti, b'aj ay te' bálsamo.

Ayik ol ab'ani ichato ay mach wan sb'eyek' t'a sk'ab'tak te te' chi', tzach och ak' owal yet' heb'. Ha jun chi' syalelk'ochi to a in ol in b'ab'laj t'a eyichanh yik tzin milancham heb' soldado filisteo chi', xchi Jehová.
Icha ix aj yalan Dios, icha wal chi' ix yutej winhaj David chi', yuj chi' ix satel heb' soldado filisteo chi', ix b'atnhej t'a Gabaón masanto ix k'och t'a Gezer.
Icha wal chi' ix aj sk'echaanh sb'inajnakil winhaj rey David t'a masanil nación. Ha Jehová ix ak'an xiwk'e masanil nación chi' t'a winh.
Ix schekan winhaj rey David b'ochajk'e juntzanh pat t'a jun chonhab' skuch Schonhab' winhaj David. Ix sik'anel jun lugar winh b'aj tz'aj te' skaxail strato Dios t'a yol jun mantiado ix b'ochaji.

Yuj chi' ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha heb' manh levitaok, max yal yik'anb'ey te' skaxail trato heb', yujto a Jehová ix sik'anel heb' levita chi' yik syik'an b'ey te' kaxa chi' heb', yik tz'ak'jipax serwil yuj heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yawtejkot masanil heb' yetisraelal winh, ix smolb'ej sb'a heb' t'a Jerusalén, yik sb'at ik'chajkot te' skaxail strato Jehová yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'ilxo yuj winh.
Ix smolb'an pax masanil heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón winh yet' juntzanhxo heb' levita.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coat, 120 heb' ix molchaji, a winhaj Uriel yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Merari, 220 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Asaías yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, 130 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Joel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Elizafán, 200 heb' ix molchaji: Ha winhaj Semaías yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón, 80 heb' ix molchaji. Ha winhaj Eliel yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Uziel, 112 heb' ix molchaji, a winhaj Aminadab yajal yaj t'a masanil heb' sk'ab'yok.

Ix yawtan heb' winh sacerdote winhaj rey David chi', haton winhaj Sadoc, winhaj Abiatar yet' pax juntzanhxo heb' winh levita, haton winhaj Uriel, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Joel, winhaj Semaías, winhaj Eliel yet' winhaj Aminadab.

Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ha ex levita ex tik, yajal heyaj t'a skal masanil heb' he k'ab' eyok, b'oek he b'a icha yalan ley yet' masanil heb' he k'ab' eyok, yik syal eyik'ankot te' skaxail strato Jehová ko Diosal, yik tz'ochkan te' t'a jun lugar b'ob'il wuuj.
Yujto ha t'a sb'ab'elal, manhok ex ix eyik'kot te', yuj chi' ix kot yowal sk'ool Jehová ko Diosal t'a kib'anh, yujto manh chamok ix ko k'anb'ej kab'i tas sko k'ulej, xchi winh.
Yuj chi', ix sakb'itan sb'a heb' winh icha yalan ley, yik wach' syal yik'ankot te' skaxail strato Jehová sDiosal Israel chi' heb' winh.
Ix sb'akhankot te' heb' winh t'a sjolom sjenhjab' yet' te' sb'akhlab'il, icha ajnak yalankan winhaj Moisés yuj Jehová.

Ix yalanpax winhaj rey David chi' t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' levita to ha t'a skal yinhtilal heb' winh chi', sik'chajelta heb' winh sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', haton salterio, arpa yet' platillo.

Yuj chi' ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal Leví chi' ix sik'chajel heb' winh stzinhan platillo, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Hemán yuninal winhaj Joel yet' winhaj Asaf yuninal winhaj Berequías sk'ab'yok winhaj Hemán chi' yet' winhaj Etán yuninal winhaj Cusaías. Ha heb' winh tik yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Merari. Ix sik'chajpaxoch juntzanhxo heb' winh tz'ak'an te' arpa: Haton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jaaziel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Uni, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Maaseías, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Elifelehu, winhaj Micnías yet' heb' winh stanhwan puerta, haton winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel.
Haxo winhaj Quenanías yajalil heb' winh levita chi'. Ha winh skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', yujto te jelan winh.

Haxo heb' winh stanhwan te' skaxail trato: Haton winhaj Berequías, winhaj Elcana, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jehías. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Sebanías, winhaj Josafat, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Amasías, winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Eliezer. Haton heb' winh spu'an trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Dios chi'.

Ha winhaj rey David yet' masanil heb' winh yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' winh soldado, te tzalajk'olal yaj heb' ayik ix xit' yik'an te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' heb' t'a spat winhaj Obed-edom chi'.
Ix och wal Dios yet' heb' levita chi' ayik ix yik'ankot te' kaxa chi' heb', yuj chi' ix yak' ukwanh nok' mam wakax heb' yet' ukwanh nok' ch'ak kalnel silab'il.

Ha pichul lino te wach' ayoch yuj winhaj rey David chi', icha pax chi' yik heb' winh levita b'akhjinak te' kaxa chi' yet' yik heb' winh sb'itani yet' yik winhaj Quenanías skuchb'an heb' winh. Ay pax och jun chaleka nab'a lino yuj winhaj rey David chi'.
Masanil heb' israel ix el yaw heb' yuj tzalajk'olal ayik ix ik'jikot te' skaxail strato Jehová chi', ix puchaj nok' ch'aak kalnel yet' trompeta, ix tzinhji platillo, salterio yet' arpa.

Ayik ix jawi te' skaxail strato Jehová chi' t'a Schonhab' winhaj rey David, haxo ix Mical ix yetb'eyum winh, haton ix yisil winhaj Saúl, ix elta t'anhan ix t'a swentena. Ayik ix yilan ix to a winhaj rey David chi', sk'echennaj winh yuj tzalajk'olal, yuj chi' ix schakel winh ix t'a spensar.

Ix ak'jioch te' skaxail strato Dios chi' t'a yol jun mantiado b'ob'ilxok'e yuj winhaj rey David chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix snhusan juntzanh silab' heb' stz'a smasanil yet' juntzanh silab' yik junk'olal yet' Dios.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan wach' lolonel winh rey chi' t'a yib'anh masanil heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová.
