Ix yak'an junjun ixim pan winh yet' jab'jab' nok' chib'ej yet' juntzanh te' takinh sat uwa t'a junjun anima chi'.

Ix yak'ankanoch yopisio heb' winh levita winh yik smunlaj heb' winh b'aj ay te' skaxail strato Jehová, haton heb' winh chi' yowalil tz'ak'an yuj diosal, syalanpax wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel t'a b'ital.

Ha mach skuchb'an heb' winh t'a b'it chi', haton winhaj Asaf, haxo winh schab'il, haton winhaj Zacarías. Slajwi chi' skot pax winhaj Jeiel, winhaj Semiramot, winhaj Jehiel, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Eliab, winhaj Benaía, winhaj Obed-edom yet' winhaj Jeiel. Haton heb' winh chi' ay syamk'ab' yik b'it, ay salterio heb' winh, ay pax yarpa heb' winh. Haxo winhaj Asaf chi' stzinhan platillo.
Haxo pax heb' winh sacerdote: Haton winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Jahaziel, a heb' winh spu'annhej k'een trompeta t'a yichanh te' skaxail strato Dios.
Ha t'a jun k'u chi' b'ab'elto ix yal winhaj rey David t'a winhaj Asaf yet' pax t'a heb' winh ayoch yet' winh to sb'itej juntzanh ak'oj yuj diosal tik heb' winh t'a Jehová:
Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová. Kalekel yab'ixal. Kalek t'a masanil chonhab' tas ix sk'ulej.
Ko b'itejek b'it yuj kik'anchaanh. Kalekel tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová.
Konh tzalajek yujto yik onhxo. Ayokab' tzalajk'olal yik skak'anem ko b'a t'ay.
Ko k'anek skolwal Jehová, kak'ekem ko b'a t'ay t'a masanil tiempo.
Ha onh yuninal onh winhaj Jacob schekab' Jehová, a onh chonhab' israel onh tik, to sik'b'il onh eli, ko naekkot tastak satub'tak yilji sk'ulejnak Jehová yet' tas syutej sch'olb'itan t'a stojolal.
Ha Jehová ko Diosal, Yajal t'a masanil sat lu'um tik.
Syak'nhej elk'och strato t'a masanil k 'inal. Ha tas yalnakkani, syak'nhej elk'och t'a smilal makanhil anima tz'eq'ui,
haton jun strato sb'onak yet' winhaj Abraham, b'aj yak'nakpax sti' t'a winhaj Isaac.
Ley ajnakkan jun tik t'a winhaj Jacob. Ha jun strato tik ix kan t'ayonh a onh israel onh tik t'a junelnhej,
ayik yalannakkan Jehová icha tik: Ol wak' lum Canaán t'ayach, ol ochkan lum a makb'enok, xchinakkan t'a winhaj Jacob chi'.
Jaywanhanto sb'isul heb' ta'. Tonhej skomon ek' heb' t'a sat lum lum tik.
Tzijtum chonhab' b'aj ek'nak kajan heb' t'a yoltak smakb'en heb' rey.
Manh yalnakoklaj sk'ool Dios ixtajnak heb', yuj chi' icha tik yalnak t'a juntzanh heb' rey chi':
Manh eyixtej heb' in chekab' sik'b'ilel tik, xchi.
Konh b'itanek t'a Jehová ko masanil a onh kajan onh t'a sat lu'um tik. Kalekeli to tzonh skolnhej Jehová t'a junjun k'u.
Kalekel sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' tas satub'tak yilji sk'ulej t'a masanil chonhab' yet' t'a masanil nación.
Yujto a Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, smoj wal tz'alchaj wach' lolonel t'ay. Te ay spoder t'a yichanh juntzanh komon Dios.
Ha sdiosal juntzanh chonhab', malaj jab'ok yelk'ochi, palta a Jehová b'oannak satcha'anh.
Niwan chekel sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' sb'inajnakil. Ha swach'il yilji yet' spoder scheklaj t'a skajnub'.
Ex anima t'a junjun chonhab', alek to a Jehová te niwan yelk'ochi, te ay pax spoder.
Alek wach' lolonel t'ay yujto niwan yelk'ochi. Ochanhek yet' eyofrenda t'a yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová. Ochanhek ejmelal t'ay t'a skajnub' te wach' yilji.
Ib'xokab'k'e masanil anima t'a yichanh. A' ix tzatzb'itan yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' max ib'xilaj.
Tzalajokab' satcha'anh yet' lum lum tik. Kalek yab' junjun chonhab' to a Jehová rey toni.
k'anhokab' ha' mar, elokab' yaw masanil tas ay t'a yol ha'. Tzalajokab' masanil lum lum b'aj sb'o munlajel yet' masanil tastak ay t'a sat lu'um.
Elokab' yaw te' niwak te' t'a yichanh Jehová yuj tzalajk'olal, yujto sja yak' yajalil t'a sat lu'um tik.
Kaq'ek yuj diosal t'a Jehová yujto wach'nhej, tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo.
Kalek icha tik: Mamin, ko Kolumal ach, kolonh. Tzonh a molb'anxikot t'a skal juntzanh ch'ok nacional, yik skak' yuj diosal, skalan wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a tzalajk'olal.

Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal t'a masanil tiempo a onh israel onh tik, xe chi, xchi winhaj David chi'. Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan masanil anima: Ujokab' icha tzal chi', xchi heb'. Yuj chi' ix yal wach' lolonel heb' t'a Jehová.
Ixlajwi chi', a winhaj rey David chi' ix ak'ankanoch winhaj Asaf yet' heb' winh yetlevitail yik syilannhej heb' winh yoch ejmelal b'aj ix kan te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a junjun k'u.

Ix kanpax winhaj Obed-edom yet' 68 heb' winh ajun yet' winh yik skolwaj heb' winh yet' heb' winh. Haxo pax winhaj Obed-edom yuninal winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Hosa, a heb' winh ix tanhwankan spatil chi'.
Ix kanpax winhaj sacerdote Sadoc yet' heb' winh yetsacerdoteal ajun yet'ok yik syilan heb' winh yoch ejmelal t'a skajnub' Dios t'a Gabaón, haton jun anhej Jehová ay yiko'.
Ha heb' winh snhusan silab' t'a Jehová t'a masanil tiempo t'a altar, t'a q'uinhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'ualil, icha wal yajkan t'a sley Jehová ak'b'ilkan yuj t'a chonhab' Israel.

Ha yet' heb' winh sacerdote chi', ix kan pax winhaj Hemán, winhaj Jedutún yet' pax jaywanhxo heb' winh sik'b'ileli yik sb'itan heb' winh, syalan heb' winh icha tik: Kalek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová, yujto tzonh xajanej t'a masanil tiempo, xchi heb' t'a sb'it chi'.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh tik, spu k'een strompeta heb' winh, stzinhan splatillo heb' winh yet' juntzanh yamk'ab' yik b'it t'a Dios. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jedutún chi' stanhwan ti' puerta.
Ixlajwi chi', ix laj meltzaj masanil heb' anima chi' t'a spat. Ix meltzaj pax winhaj rey David yik b'at yalan wach' lolonel winh t'a yib'anh masanil heb' kajan yet'ok t'a spat.

Ayik kajanxoek' winhaj rey David t'a yol spalacio ix yalan winh t'a winhaj Natán schekab' Dios icha tik: --Ilnab'i, a in tik ayinxo och t'a yol in palacio nab'a k'ute' ayoch t'ay, palta haxo skaxail strato Jehová, ha t'a yol mantiado ayeq'ui, xchi winh.
Ix tak'wi winhaj Natán chi' icha tik: --Syalnhej a b'oan masanil tas tza nib'ej yujto ayoch Dios het'ok, xchi winh.
Ha t'a jun ak'wal chi' ix lolon Dios t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yalan t'a winh icha tik:
Ixik, b'at al t'a winh in chekab' aj David to a in Jehová in swal icha tik t'a winh: Manhok ach ol a b'ok'e junok in templo b'aj ol in kajnajok.
Yiktax wik'annakelta heb' he mam eyicham t'a Egipto masanto tiknaik, manta b'aj tzin kajnaj t'a yol junok pat, palta to anhej t'a yoltak mantiado ix in ajeq'ui.

Masanil tiempo ix in b'eyek' yet' heb' he mam eyicham chi', malaj b'aj walnak t'a heb' yajalil heb' skuchb'ani to sb'o junok templo heb' nab'a k'ute' tz'och t'ay b'aj tzin kajnaji, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh.
Tzalanpax t'a winh to a in swal icha tik: Ha in Jehová Yajal waj t'a smasanil, a in swal icha tik: Ha in ix ach wik'el t'a tanhwum kalnelal yik tzach och yajalil t'a in chonhab' Israel tik.
B'ajtaktil ix ach eq'ui ayinnhej och het'ok, ix in satel masanil heb' ajk'ol ix ak'an owal het'ok, ol ach wak'an b'inajok, icha sb'inaj heb' niwak yajal ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik.

Hanhejtona' ix in sik'elta jun lum b'aj tzex kajnajkan a ex in chonhab' ex tik. Ha tik ol ex kannhej kajan t'a junelnhej. Manhxa mach ol ex xib'tanok, manhxo ol ex tzuntzaj yuj heb' eyajk'ool icha ix ex yutej heb' t'a sb'ab'elal,
ayik ix wak'anoch heb' ix ex kuchb'ani. Ha in ol in satel masanil heb' eyajk'ool. Swak'anpax ojtakejeli to ol wak'nhej opisio t'a heb' inhtilal.
Ayik ol lajwokek' a k 'inal, yik mukb'il hachxo, ol wak'och junok uninal reyal a k'exulok, tek'an wal ol wutej yopisio chi'.
Ha jun uninal chi' ol b'oank'e in templo b'aj ol in b'inajok. Ha in ol wak'nhejkan yopisio chi' t'a yinhtilal.

Ha in ol in och smamok, haxo ol och wuninalok. Malaj b'ak'uinh ol waktejkan in xajanani. Manh ichaok wutejnak waktankan in xajanan winhaj Saúl, wik'nakel winh t'a yopisio yik ach och sk'exulok winh, manh ichok ta' ol wutok.
Ol wak'nhej yopisio uninal chi' t'a in chonhab'. Ha yopisio chi' ol b'eynhejb'at t'a masanil tiempo, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a winh, xchi t'a winhaj Natán chi'.
Yuj chi' masanil tas ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Natán chi', ix yal winh t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Yuj chi' ix och winh rey chi' t'a yichanh Jehová, ix em k'ojan winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová in Diosal, ¿tas wal welk'och a in tik? ¿tas pax wal yelk'och heb' in mam wicham, yuj chi' niwan a wach'k'olal tzak' t'ayin?

Ach in Diosal, manhoknhej juntzanh tik ix ak' t'ayin, wan alanpaxkani to ol ak' a wach'k'olal t'a yib'anh heb' winhtilal t'a b'ak'uinh. Lajan tzin utej icha juntzanh heb' niwak winak t'a sat lu'um tik.
¿Tasto wal syal walan t'ayach yuj sniwanil welk'och tzak'a'? Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, ojtak wal tas waji.
Mamin Jehová, yujto tzin a xajanej a in a chekab' in tik, yuj chi' ix el t'a a k'ool, ix ak'an juntzanh opisio satub'tak tik t'ayin, ix ak'an wojtakejeli.
Mamin Jehová, malaj junokxo mach lajan het'ok. Ha achnhej toni, malaj junokxo Dios skab' spekal icha ach tik.

Ha onh pax a chonhab' Israel onh tik, malaj junokxo chonhab' lajan ket'ok, yujto a ach ix onh a kolo', yik tzonh ochkan a chonhab'ok. Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, te niwan ix aj a b'inaj kuuj, yujto a k'ulejnak tas satub'tak ayik a kolannakelta heb' ko mam kicham t'a Egipto. Ik'annakel juntzanhxo chonhab' t'a yichanh heb'.
Yujto ix onh ak'och a chonhab'ok t'a junelnhej. Ha hachxo Mamin Jehová, ach ochkan ko Diosalok.
Ha tiknaik Mamin Jehová, elokab'k'och tas ix alkan t'ayin a in a chekab' in tik yet' t'a heb' winhtilal.

Elokab'k'och tas ix ala', yik wach' tzach ik'jichaanh. Mamin Jehová, ol alchajok to a ach Yajal aj t'a Smasanil, ko Diosal ach pax a onh israel onh tik. Ol ochnhej pax winhtilal t'a reyal t'a junelnhej t'a ichanh.
Mamin ach in Diosal, ix ak' wojtakejeli to ol ochnhejkan winhtilal t'a wopisio. Yuj chi' tzin tek'b'ej in b'a in lesalwi t'ayach.
Ha ach tik Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, a ach ix alkan jun wach'ilal tik t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, elokab' t'a a k'ol ak'an a wach'k'olal t'a winhtilal, yik wach' ol ajnhej ek' heb' t'a ichanh. Ha ach ol ak' a wach'k'olal t'a heb', ol schaannhej heb' t'a masanil tiempo, xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a Jehová.
Ayik ix lajwi yek' juntzanh tik, ix ak'ji ganar heb' filisteo yuj winhaj rey David. Ix kan heb' t'a yalanh smandar winh. Ix yik'anek' chonhab' Gat winh yet' yaldeail t'a yol sk'ab' heb'.
Ix ak'jipax ganar heb' moabita yuj winh, yuj chi' ix yak'och sb'a heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, ix ak'jikanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'an k'een tumin t'a winh.
Hanhejtona' ix ak'jipax ganar winhaj Hadad-ezer sreyal Soba ay t'a stojolal Hamat yuj winh. Ha jun winh rey chi' wan smakan yikok lum lum masanto t'a ha' Éufrates.

Ix yamchaj mil carruaje yik owal yuj winhaj David chi' yet' heb' soldado. Ix yamchajpax 7 mil heb' soldado ayk'e t'a yib'anh chej yet' pax 20 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok. Ix spol t'inhchaj sch'anhal yok masanil nok' chej et'jinak carruaje yik owal chi' heb', haxonhej nok' sk'anchaj yik stok'an 100 carruaje ix kani.
Ix k'och heb' soldado sirio aj Damasco yik skolwaj heb' yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', palta ix ak'jipax ganar heb' yuj winhaj rey David chi', ix miljicham 22 mil heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yak'ankan juntzanh heb' soldado winh t'a skal heb' sirio aj Damasco chi'. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh, ix ak'jikanoch t'a yib'anh heb' yak'an k'een tumin t'a winh. B'ajtak ix yak' owal winhaj David chi', ix yak'nhej ganar winh yuj Jehová.
Hanhejtona', ix yik'anpaxek' juntzanh maklab' jul-lab' winh ayoch oro t'ay sk'an heb' yajalil heb' soldado winhaj Hadad-ezer chi', ix yik'ankot heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Niwan pax k'een bronce ix yik'ek' winh t'a Tibhat yet' t'a Cun, haton juntzanh chonhab' chi' ay t'a yol smakb'en winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi'. Haton yet' k'een bronce chi' ix sb'o jun niwan pila winhaj rey Salomón. Ix sb'o pax juntzanh niwak oy winh yet' masanil yamk'ab' nab'a bronce ix k'anchaj t'a templo.
Ayik ix yab'an winhaj Toi sreyal Hamat to toxo ix ak'ji ganar masanil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' yuj winhaj rey David,

ix schekankot jun yuninal winh, skuchan Adoram. Yet'nak k'een oro winh, k'een plata yet' k'een bronce yik tz'ak'ji stzatzil sk'ool winhaj rey David yet' yalan wach' lolonel t'a winh, yujto ix ak'ji ganar winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' yuj winh. Ha winhaj Toi chi' yak'nak owal winh yet' winhaj rey Hadad-ezer chi' t'a yalanhtaxo.

Ix yak' masanil juntzanh k'een chi' winhaj rey David t'a Jehová. Junnhej ix aj yak'an k'een winh yet' k'een oro yet' k'een plata yik'nakek' winh t'a juntzanh nación tik: Haton t'a Edom, t'a Moab, t'a Amón, t'a heb' filisteo yet' t'a heb' amalecita.
Yet' pax winhaj Abisai yune' ix Sarvia, yajalil jun makan heb' soldado winhaj rey David, ix ak'ji ganar heb' soldado yik Edom yuj winh. 18 mil heb' ix smilcham winh t'a yak'likal Atz'am Atz'am.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ankan juntzanh heb' soldado winh t'a Edom chi'. Yuj chi' masanil heb' edomita ix ochkan t'a yol sk'ab' winhaj rey David chi'. B'ajtak ix yak' owal winh, ix yak'nhej ganar winh yuj Jehová.
Ha winhaj David, ix yak' reyal winh t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Te wach' ix yutej sb'eyb'al winh, t'a stojolal ix sb'o yaj winh tas yaj heb' chonhab'.
Ha winh yajalil heb' soldado, haton winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia. Haxo pax winhaj Josafat yuninal winhaj Ahilud, tz'ib'um yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'.
Ha winhaj Sadoc yuninal winhaj Ahitob yet' winhaj Abimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar, sacerdote heb' winh, haxo winhaj Savsa, tz'ib'um ab'ix winh.

Ha pax winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj Joiada, yajal yaj winh t'a heb' quereteo yet' t'a heb' peleteo, haton heb' stanhwumal winh rey, haxo heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi', yajal yaj heb' yik skolwaj heb' yet' winh.
Ayik toxo ix ek' jun pekti', ix cham winhaj Nahas sreyal heb' amonita, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Hanún ix ochkan reyal.

Ix sna' winhaj rey David to yowalil sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi', yujto a winh smam winh ix sch'ox swach'k'olal winh t'a winh. Yuj chi' ix schekb'at juntzanh schekab' winhaj David chi' t'a winhaj Hanún chi' yik syak'an sniwanil sk'ool winh yuj schamel winh smam winh chi'. Palta ayik ix k'och heb' winh chekab' t'a schonhab' heb' amonita,

a heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi', ix yal heb' winh t'a winhaj Hanún chi': Mamin rey, ¿tom tzak'och t'a a k'ool to niwan yelk'och winh a mam chi' t'a yol sat winhaj rey David chi', yujnhej chi' ix schekkot juntzanh winak tik winh yik syak' sniwanil a k'ool heb' winh? Maay. Ix chekjikot heb' winh yuj winh yik syil heb' winh tas yaj ko chonhab' tik, yik tzul satanel heb' winh, xchi heb' winh t'a winh.

Yuj chi', ix schek winhaj Hanún chi' yamjok heb' winh schekab' winhaj rey David chi'. Ix joxjiel xil sti' heb' winh, ix poljiel yoktak sti' spichul heb' winh masanto ix k'eul t'a sti' syoop heb' winh. Ixlajwi chi' ix schekan pax heb' winh winh.

Ayik ix yab'an winhaj rey David tas ix aj heb' winh, ix schekanb'at schaumal heb' winh yujto te q'uixwelal ix utaj heb' winh. Ix alji t'a heb' winh to skan heb' winh t'a Jericó masanto sq'uib'xi xil sti' heb' winh chi', ichato chi' syal smeltzaj paxta heb' winh.

Haxo heb' amonita chi', ix nachajel yuj heb' to chuk ix kan heb' t'a winhaj rey David chi', yuj chi' ix yak'b'at 660 quintal k'een plata winhaj Hanún chi' t'a Mesopotamia, t'a Siria, t'a Maaca yet' t'a Soba yik skot carruaje yet' heb' winh soldado et'jinak yet' heb' winh soldado ayk'e yib'anh nok' chej yik skolwaj yet' winh.

Ix stupanpax heb' t'a winh sreyal Maaca yik skot winh yet' 32 mil carruaje yik owal yet' soldado. Ix sb'oank'e scampamento heb' ix tupchaj chi' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Medeba. Ix elpaxkot masanil heb' amonita chi' t'a yoltak schonhab', ix smolb'an sb'a heb' yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' israel.
Ayik ix yab'an jun chi' winhaj rey David ix schekanb'at winhaj Joab winh yet' masanil heb' soldado.
Ix yak' lista sb'a heb' amonita chi' t'a owal t'a yichanh schonhab' heb'. Haxo heb' winh rey ix yawtejkot heb' chi', ch'ok ix kan heb' winh t'a ak'lik.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Joab to ay heb' ajk'ol t'a yichanh yet' t'a spatik, ix sik'anel heb' soldado te jelan winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' sirio chi'.
Haxo nanhalxo heb' ix yak'och winh yik skuchb'aj heb' yuj winhaj Abisai yuk'tak winh yik syak'an owal heb' yet' heb' amonita chi'.
Ix yalan winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: Tato max onh tzak'wan t'a heb' sirio chi', elanhchamel tzex kolwaj ket'ok. Tato max ex tzak'wan t'a heb' amonita chi' jun, a onhxo ol b'at onh kolwaj heyet'ok.
Tek'b'ej a b'a, kak' owal yuj ko kolan heb' ketchonhab', haton schonhab' ko Diosal. Yak'okab' Jehová tas tz'el t'a sk'ool, xchi winhaj Joab chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at winhaj Joab chi' yet' heb' soldado yak' owal yet' heb' sirio chi'. Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winh.

Ayik ix yilan heb' amonita to toxo ix el lemnaj heb' sirio chi', ix el pax lemnaj heb' t'a yichanh winhaj Abisai chi', ix och heb' skol sb'a t'a yol schonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzaj winhaj Joab chi' yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ayik ix yilan heb' sirio chi' to ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix yak'anb'at schekab' heb' t'a heb' yetchonhab' ay t'a sk'axepalb'at ha' Éufrates yik skot heb' kolwal yet' heb'. Ha winhaj Sofac yajalil heb' soldado winhaj rey Hadad-ezer skuchb'an heb'.

Ix alchaj juntzanh tik t'a winhaj rey David, yuj chi' ix smolb'anpax masanil heb' soldado Israel winh, ix k'axpajek' heb' t'a ha' Jordán, ix k'och heb' b'aj ayek' heb' sirio chi'. Ix sb'oanoch soldado winhaj rey David chi' t'a yichanh heb' sirio chi', haxo heb' ix ak'an owal yet' heb'.
Haxo ix aji, ix el lemnaj heb' sirio t'a yichanh heb' israel chi'. Ay 40 mil heb' soldado sb'ey t'a yok ix chami yet' 7 mil heb' ayk'e t'a yol carruaje. Ix champax winhaj Sofac chi'.

Ayik ix yilan heb' ayoch yet' winhaj Hadad-ezer chi' to toxo ix ak'ji ganar heb' yuj heb' israel, ix och heb' t'a junk'olal yet' winhaj rey David chi', ix kan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh. Atax ta' majxo yal sk'ol heb' sirio chi' ix kolwaj yet' heb' amonita.

Ha t'a junxo ab'il, t'a stiempoal sb'at heb' rey t'a owal, ix kan winhaj rey David t'a Jerusalén, haxo winhaj Joab ix molb'anb'at heb' soldado yetisraelal yik syixtanb'at heb' tastak ay t'a yol smakb'en heb' amonita. Ix b'atnhej heb', ix yoymitan chonhab' Rabá heb', ix yak'an owal heb' yet'ok, masanto ix yak' ganar jun chonhab' chi' heb'.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'och winhaj rey David yik'kot scorona winh sreyal heb' amonita chi'. Nab'a oro jun corona chi', tzijtum k'een k'een wach' yilji ayoch t'ay, ay am oxeok arroba yalil. Ix yak'ank'e heb' t'a sjolom winhaj rey David chi'. Manh jantakok tas karo stojol ix yik' winh t'a jun chonhab' chi'.

Haxo masanil heb' anima ixto kani, ix ik'jib'at heb' yuj winh, ix ak'chajoch heb' t'a munlajel yet' k'een sierra, k'een piocha yet' k'een ch'akab'. Hanheja' icha chi' ix sk'ulej winh yet' heb' amonita t'a juntzanhxo chonhab'. Ixlajwi chi' ix meltzajkot winh yet' masanil heb' soldado t'a Jerusalén.

Ixlajwi chi' ix och jun owal yet' heb' filisteo t'a Gezer. Ha t'a jun owal chi', a winhaj Sibecai aj Husa ix milancham winhaj Sipai. Ha winhaj Sipai chi' yinhtilal winh heb' chaanh steel. Icha chi' ix aj skan heb' filisteo t'a yol sk'ab' heb' israel.

Ix och junxo owal yet' heb' filisteo chi'. Ha winhaj Elhanán yuninal winhaj Jair ix milancham winhaj Lahmi yuk'tak winhaj Goliat aj Gat. Te niwan spatik yok slanza winhaj Lahmi chi', icha am spatik te te' b'aj sb'ak'chajoch anh ch'al yik heb' sch'alwi.
Ix och junxo owal t'a Gat. Ay junxo winh winak ta' te chaanh steel, lajchawe' yiximal sk'ab' winh, lajchawe' pax yiximal yok winh, yinhtilal pax winh heb' chaanh steel.
Ha jun winh chi', ix b'uchwaj winh t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Simea yuk'tak winhaj rey David chi'.
Ha juntzanh heb' winh niwak winak chi', a winhaj Réfah aj Gat ay yinhtilal heb' winh, palta ix miljicham heb' winh yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' soldado winh.
Ha winh Satanás ix och ajk'olal t'a heb' israel, yuj chi' ix yak' winh sk'ulej winhaj rey David yik syik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' soldado israel winh smasanil.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winhaj Joab yet' pax t'a heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado icha tik: --Ixikek eyik'chaanh sb'isul heb' soldado. Sb'at he chakot t'a chonhab' Beerseba, masanto tzex k'och t'a chonhab' Dan. Ayik slajwi chi' tzeyik'ankot sb'isul heb' chi' t'ayin, yik swila' jantak heb' t'a smasanil.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj Joab chi' icha tik: --Aokab' Jehová tz'ak'an q'uib' sb'isul schonhab' masanto maxtzak yal sb'ischaji. Mamin rey ayoch heb' t'a yol a k'ab' smasanil, ¿tas yuj tza nib'ej jun tik? Ha t'a jun tik ol och smul ko chonhab' tik uuj, xchi winh.
Palta majxo schalaj yab' winh rey chi' tas ix yal winhaj Joab chi', yuj chi' ix b'at heb'. Ayik ix lajwi yik'anchaanh sb'isul masanil heb' soldado Israel chi' heb', ix meltzaj heb' t'a Jerusalén.

Ix yak'an jantak sb'isul masanil heb' winh soldado winhaj Joab t'a winhaj David chi', ay 470 mil heb' winh soldado yik Judá yet' pax t'a juntzanhxo smakb'en Israel ay jun millón yet' 100 mil heb' winh winak stiempo sb'at t'a owal.
Palta maj ochlaj heb' winh winak yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh yik Benjamín sb'isulok, yujto maj scha sk'ol winhaj Joab jun scheknab'il winh rey chi'.
Maj schapaxlaj sk'ol jun chi' Dios, yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun yaelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi'.

Ichato chi' ix yalank'eta smul winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios icha tik: --Te niwan in mul ix ochi, yujto ix in k'ulej jun tik, palta tzin k'an t'ayach to tzak' niwank'olal jun in mul tik, yujto icha junok kistal anima ix wutej in b'a, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Jehová t'a winhaj Gad schekab', haton winh tz'ak'an srazón winh rey chi', ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik, b'at il winhaj rey David, tzalan t'a winh to a in Jehová in swal icha tik: Ay oxe' tas swak' a sik'lej, a ach ol a sik'lej tas junok ol wak' t'ayach, xchi Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winhaj Gad chi' yil winhaj rey David chi', ix yalan winh t'a winh icha tik: --Ha Jehová tz'alan icha tik: Sik'lej junok t'a skal juntzanh yaelal tik:

¿Tom ha' oxe' ab'il wejel, ma oxe' ujal ol yak' heb' ajk'ol ex smilanchamok, mato oxe' k'ual ilya ol yak' t'a yol a makb'en tik? Ha jun chi' wespada a in Jehová in tik, yujto a jun wángel ol satanel anima t'a yol a makb'en tik, xchi Jehová. Yuj chi' sik'lej tiknaik yik wach' ol yal wak'an spak t'a Jehová, haton in chekankoti, xchi winhaj Gad chi' t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Gad chi' icha tik: --Maxtzak nachajlaj wuuj tas tzin sik'lej. Wach' hama to a Jehová tz'em sk'ab' t'a wib'anh, manhok anima swa sk'ab' t'ayin, yujto wojtak to niwan yok'elk'olal Jehová chi', xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yak'kot jun ilya Jehová t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel chi', 70 mil heb' ix cham yuj.

Ix schekankot jun yángel Jehová yik satanel heb' anima t'a Jerusalén. Ayik wan satanel heb' anima chi', ix kusk'e sk'ol Jehová yuj jun yaelal chi', ix yalan t'a jun yángel wan smilancham anima chi' icha tik: Yechelxo chi', aktej, xchi t'ay. Ha wal t'a jun rato chi', a jun yángel Jehová chi', ay wal ek' b'aj wan stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo.

Haxo ix k'e k'elan winhaj rey David, ix yilan winh to ayek' jun yángel Jehová chi' t'a snanhal lum lum tik yet' satcha'anh, yet'nakk'e jun k'een espada, wan yak'anem k'een yespada chi' t'a yib'anh Jerusalén. Yet'nhej chi' ix em nhojan winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' Israel masanto t'a sat lu'um, ayoch pichul yik kusk'olal yuj heb'.

Ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a Dios icha tik: --Mamin, a in wal ix wala' to tz'ik'jichaanh sb'isul heb' chonhab' tik. Ha in wal ix och in mul. Malaj smul heb' anima tik. Mamin Jehová, ach in Diosal, tzin tewi t'ayach to a jun yaelal tik, ha t'a wib'anh yet' winhtilal tz'emi, manh a satel a chonhab' tik, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' ix yal Yángel Jehová chi' t'a winhaj Gad to syal winh t'a winhaj rey David chi' to sb'ok'e junok altar winh b'aj stek'wi trigo winhaj Ornán jebuseo chi'.
Yuj chi' ix b'at winh rey chi' sb'ok'e jun altar yik tz'ik'jichaanh sb'i Jehová, icha ix aj yalchaj chi'.
Ha winhaj Ornán yet' chanhwanh yuninal winh, wan stek'wi trigo heb', haxo ix yilan heb' to ayek' Yángel Jehová chi' ta', ix b'at heb' winh yuninal winh chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj Ornán chi' to wan sk'och winh rey t'a slak'anil, ix elta winh b'aj wan stek'wi trigo chi', ix em nhojan winh t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi' ix yal winh rey chi' t'a winh icha tik: --Tzok wal el t'a a k'ool, tza chonh jun lugar b'aj tzach tek'wi trigo tik t'ayin, yik tzin b'ok'e junok altar t'a Jehová, yik tz'och waan jun ilya tik t'a kal chonhab' tik. Chonh t'ayin icha wal jantak stojol, xchi winh rey chi'.

Ix tak'wi winhaj Ornán chi' t'a winh: --Mamin rey, syal in sian jun lugar tik t'ayach yik tza b'oan tas snib'ej a k'ool. Swak'anpax nok' toro yik tz'och nok' silab'il yet' te' tek'lab' tik syal yoch te' t'a k'atzitzal, haxo ixim trigo tik, syal yoch ixim t'a ofrendail. Mamin rey, masanil juntzanh tik swak' t'ayach, xchi winh.

Palta ix tak'wi winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: --Yuj wal Dios t'ayach yuj masanil juntzanh tik, palta a in tik yowalil ol in tup juntzanh tik smasanil icha wal stojol, yujto max yal-laj wik'anek' a tastak, swak'an silab'il t'a Jehová. Max yal-laj wak'an junok tas silab'il to manh ol in tupu', xchi winh.
Icha chi' ix aj smanan jun lu'um chi' winh rey chi' t'a 600 siclo k'een oro.

Hata' ix sb'ok'e jun altar winh, ix snhusan silab' winh yet' silab' yik junk'olal. Ixlajwi chi', ix lesalwi winh t'a Jehová, haxo Jehová chi' ix ak'ankot k'ak' t'a satcha'anh t'a yib'anh jun silab' t'a yib'anh altar chi'.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan Jehová t'a jun ángel chi' to syak'xiem k'een yespada chi' t'a yol yatut.
Ayik ix yilan winhaj rey David to ix tak'wi Jehová t'a winh t'a stek'lab' trigo winhaj Ornán chi', ix yak'an juntzanhxo silab' winh t'a Jehová ta'.
Wach'chom a jun mantiado sb'onakk'e winhaj Moisés yikok Jehová t'a tzinan lu'um yet' jun altar b'aj stz'a silab' ay t'a Gabaón jun lugar chaanh yik ejmelal,
palta maj yal-laj sb'at winhaj rey David ta' yik sk'anb'ej t'a Dios, yujto ix te xiw winh ayik ix yilan jun k'een espada winh yet'nak Yángel Jehová.
Yuj chi' ix yal winh icha tik: Ha tik ol aj stemplo Jehová Dios yet' jun altar b'aj sko nhustz'a ko silab' a onh israel onh tik, xchi winh.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' to smolchaj masanil heb' ch'ok chonhab'il ayek' kajan t'a skal heb' israel. Ix sik'chajel heb' tzeyum k'een, haton k'een ol och t'a yik sb'ochaj stemplo Dios.
Niwan pax k'een hierro ix smolb'ej heb' yik tz'och k'een t'a lawuxal sk'anchaj t'a puerta. Niwan pax k'een bronce ix molb'aji, maxtzak yal-laj yechtaj k'een.
Niwan pax te' k'ute', maxtzak nachaji jantak sb'isul te' ix molchaji, yujto a heb' aj Sidón yet' heb' aj Tiro te niwan te' k'ute' chi' ix yik'kot heb'.

Ix sna winhaj rey David chi' icha tik: Ha winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, te uninto winh, haxo pax jun stemplo Jehová ol b'o chi', te niwan ol ajok. Ol te b'inaj yuj swach'il yilji t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, yuj chi' a tiknaik yowalil ol in molb'ejkan tastak ol och t'ay, xchi winh. Yuj chi' ayik pitzanto winhaj David chi', te niwan tas ix smolb'ejkan winh.
Ixlajwi chi', ix yawtankot winhaj Salomón chi' winh, haton winh yuninal winh. Ix yalankan winh to a winh ol b'oank'e jun stemplo Jehová sDiosal chonhab' Israel.
Ix yalan winh icha tik: Ach wuninal, nab'ilxo wal wuuj to tzin b'ok'e junok stemplo Jehová ko Diosal.
Palta yalnak t'ayin icha tik: Ix wila'' to a ach tik, manh jantakok anima ix a milchamok, manh jantakok pax owal ix ak'a', yuj chi' manhok ach ol a b'ok'e jun in templo chi'.

Palta ay jun uninal toto ol ajok, Salomón ol ak' sb'iej, malaj owal ol yak'a', yujto a in ol wak'och junk'olal t'a skal yet' heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ay. Ha t'a stiempoal chi' ol wak' junk'olal yet' tzalajk'olal t'a in chonhab' Israel. A' ol b'oank'e jun in templo chi'. Ol och wuninalok, a inxo ol in och smamok. Ol wak'nhejkan yopisio t'a yinhtilal t'a chonhab' tik t'a junelnhej, xchinak Jehová t'ayin.
Yuj chi' a tiknaik ach wuninal, aokab' Jehová tz'ochnhej het'ok yik ol a b'oank'e jun templo chi', icha ajnak yalan chi' uuj.
Aokab' Jehová ko Diosal ol ak'an a jelanil, yik wach' ayik ol ak'an reyal t'a chonhab' Israel tik, ol a k'anab'ajej masanil scheknab'il.

Wach'nhej ol ajelk'och smasanil, tato ol a k'anab'ajej wal masanil sk'ayb'ub'al yet' scheknab'il yalnakkan t'a winhaj Moisés kuj a onh israel onh tik. Ak' ip, tek'annhej tzutej a b'a. Manh ak' chab'ax a k'ool, manh ach xiwok.

Ix wak' wal wip yik smolb'ajkan 66 mil quintal k'een oro yik tz'och t'a stemplo Jehová chi' yet' 660 mil quintal k'een plata yet' jun niwan b'ulanh k'een bronce yet' k'een hierro maxtzak yal yechtaji. Manh jantakok pax te te' ix in chek molb'ajkanok yet' k'een k'een. Ha hachxo ol ak' tz'akwok.

Tzijtum heb' winh munlajwum ayek' t'a yol a k'ab' ol munlaj het'ok, heb' tzeyum k'een, heb' albañil yet' heb' nhikum te'. Maxtzak b'ischaj jantak heb' winh winak te jelan t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal, icha t'a k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een bronce yet' t'a k'een hierro ol munlaj het'ok. Yuj chi' jun, ochokab' munlajel, ochokab' Jehová het'ok, xchi winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.
Ixlajwi chi' ix yalan winh t'a masanil heb' winh ayoch yajalil to tz'och heb' winh yet' winhaj Salomón chi' t'a munlajel. Ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik:

Ha Jehová ko Diosal ayoch heyet'ok. A' ix ak'annhej junk'olal t'ayonh t'a masanil ko makb'en, yujto ha' ix ak'anoch masanil juntzanh chonhab' tik t'a yol in k'ab', yuj chi' ix ochkan heb' t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová yet' t'a yol ko k'ab' a onh schonhab' onh tik.

Yuj chi' aq'ek wal och t'a he k'ool eyak'anoch he b'a t'a yol sk'ab' Jehová ko Diosal. Tzeyak' wal och t'a he k'ool he b'oank'e templo b'aj tz'ik'jichaanh Jehová chi', yik wach' ol ak'jokoch te' skaxail strato chi' t'a yool yet' pax masanil syamk'ab'il jun templo chi', xchi winh t'a heb' winh.
Ayik te icham winakxo winhaj rey David, ix yak'ankanoch yopisio winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Salomón yik tz'och winh reyal t'a chonhab' Israel.
Ix molb'aj masanil heb' winh yajal yaj t'a chonhab' chi' yuj winh, heb' winh sacerdote yet' heb' winh levita.
Ix schekan b'ischaj heb' winh levita winh, haton heb' winh winak ek'alxo t'a 30 ab'il sk'inal, 38 mil sb'isul heb' winh.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh chi', ix sik'chajel 24 mil heb' winh skuchb'an heb' smunlaji yik sb'ochaj stemplo Jehová. Haxo 6 milxo heb' winh, ix och heb' winh t'a juezal yet' t'a yajalilok chonhab' chi'.

Chanhe' mil heb' winh ix och stanhwumalok puerta. Chanhe' mil pax heb' winh ix och yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' winh t'a Jehová, sk'anan jantak yamk'ab' yik b'it heb' winh, haton juntzanh yamk'ab' scheknak winhaj rey David chi' b'ojok yik sk'anchaj ta'.
Makkiltakil ix yutej heb' winh levita chi' winh, icha smam yicham junjun makan heb' winh: Haton winhaj Gersón, winhaj Coat yet' winhaj Merari.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Gersón chi': Haton winhaj Laadán yet' winhaj Simei.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Laadán chi', oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Jehiel, winh b'ab'el yuninal winh, winhaj Zetam yet' winhaj Joel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', oxwanh pax heb' winh: Winhaj Selomit, winhaj Haziel yet' winhaj Harán. Haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a yinhtilal winhaj Laadán chi'.

Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Jahat b'ab'el, winhaj Zina schab'il, winhaj Jeús yet' winhaj Bería. Ha winhaj Jeús yet' winhaj Bería chi', manh wal tzijtumok yinhtilal heb' winh yik stzak'wan heb' yilan yopisio, yuj chi' junnhej makan ix aj heb'.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Coat, chanhwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Amram, winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.

Ha heb' yuninal winhaj Amram chi', haton winhaj Aarón yet' winhaj Moisés. Ha winhaj Aarón chi' ix sik'chajel yet' yinhtilal yuj Jehová t'a junelnhej, yik syil heb' tastak yiknhej Jehová yaji, yik snhusan incienso heb', skuchb'an heb' yetisraelal heb' yik tz'och ejmelal yet' yalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a yib'anh heb' anima t'a sb'i Jehová.
Haxo pax heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Moisés schekab' Dios jun, ix och heb' stz'akub'ok heb' yetlevitail.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Moisés, haton winhaj Gersón yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Gersón chi', a winhaj Sebuel yajal yaji.
Ha winhaj Eliezer chi' junnhej yuninal winh, haton winhaj Rehabías, winh yajal yaji. Haxo pax winhaj Rehabías chi', tzijtum yuninal winh.
Ha winhaj Selomit yuninal winhaj Izhar, yajal yaj winh.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hebrón: Haton winhaj Jerías winh b'ab'el unin, winhaj Amarías winh schab'il, winhaj Jahaziel winh yoxil yet' winhaj Jecamán winh schanhil.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Uziel: Haton winhaj Micaía winh b'ab'el yet' winhaj Isías.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari, haton winhaj Mahli yet' winhaj Musi. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi', haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis.
Ha winhaj Eleazar chi' malaj junok yuninal winh, anhej heb' ix yisil winh ay, haton heb' ix chi' ix yik' sb'a yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, heb' winh yuninal winhaj Cis.
Haxo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi, oxwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jeremot.
Haton juntzanh heb' winh chi' yinhtilal winhaj Leví, icha syal smakanhil ix aj stz'ib'chaj heb' winh ek'alxo t'a 20 ab'il sk'inal, haton juntzanh heb' winh chi' ayoch yopisio t'a templo.
Ix yal winhaj rey David icha tik: Yujto a Jehová ko Diosal ix onh ak'ankan kajan t'a tik a onh schonhab' onh tik, ix kan pax skajnub' t'a Jerusalén tik,
yuj chi' a heb' levita manhxo ol skuch b'eyek' smantiado Jehová heb' yet' pax jantak syamk'ab'il yik tz'och ejmelal, xchi winh.
Yuj chi' a heb' winh yinhtilal Leví, ayik stz'akwi 20 ab'il sk'inal heb' winh, stz'ib'an sb'a heb' winh icha ajnak yalankan winhaj rey David t'a slajwub' slolonel.

Ha heb' winh chi' ix kan heb' winh t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a stemplo Jehová, yik syilan yamaq'uil heb' winh yet' yoltak cuarto yet' yilan heb' winh sakb'itaj masanil yamk'ab' yiknhej Jehová yaji. Syilanpax juntzanh munlajel heb' winh t'a templo chi'.

Haton yik sb'ochaj ixim pan tz'och t'a yichanh Jehová, syilan ixim harina heb' winh tz'ak'ji t'a ofrendail, ixim k'oxox pan malaj yich, juntzanh ofrenda sb'ochaj t'a yol xalten yet' ixim harina kalab'il yet' aceite. Syilanpax echlab' heb' winh sk'anchaj t'a ofrenda.
Hanhejtona' yowalil aynhejek' heb' winh t'a templo chi', yuj yak'an yuj diosal heb' winh yet' aloj wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a junjun q'uinhib'alil yet' t'a yemk'ualil,

yet' yik snhuschaj silab' t'a Jehová t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, t'a sk'ual q'uinh ayik tz'alji k'een uj yet' pax juntzanhxo q'uinh te niwak yelk'ochi. Tz'ak'winhej serwil heb' winh t'a Jehová icha jantak sb'isul heb' winh yet' munlajel ak'b'il sk'ulej heb' winh.

Ha heb' winh chi' stanhwanpax mantiado b'aj sch'ox sb'a Jehová yet' skajnub' chi'. Smunlajpax heb' winh t'a stemplo Jehová chi' icha yajkan t'a yib'anh yinhtilal heb' winh yuj tas yalnakkan heb' winh sacerdote yinhtilalkan winhaj Aarón.
T'a stzolal tz'aj yilan yopisio heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón chi'. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Nadab, winhaj Abiú, winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar.

Ha winhaj Nadab yet' winhaj Abiú chi', b'ab'laj chamnak heb' winh t'a yichanh winh smam chi'. Mantalaj yuninal heb' winh schamnak heb' winh chi', yuj chi' anhej winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Itamar ix och sacerdoteal.
Makkiltak ix aj heb' winh sacerdote yuj winhaj rey David chi', yuj winhaj Sadoc yinhtilal winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Ahimelec yinhtilal winhaj Itamar.

Haxo ix yilan heb' winh to a heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi' tzijtum sb'isul heb' winh t'a yichanh heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, yuj chi' 16 makan ix aj heb' winh, haxo heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi', wajxak makannhej heb' winh.

T'a sorteoal ix aj yochkan junjun makan heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, yujto ha t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar ay heb' winh niwak yajal sik'b'iloch t'a yopisio t'a templo t'a yichanh Dios.

Ha heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar yet' pax heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar, ix sik' sorteo heb' winh t'a stzolal, jun yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Eleazar chi', jun pax yik heb' winh yinhtilalkan winhaj Itamar chi'. Icha chi' ix aj smunlaj heb' winh t'a yopisio. Haxo winhaj Semaías yuninal winhaj Natanael yinhtilalkan winhaj Leví ix tz'ib'an sb'i heb' winh ayik ix sik'an sorteo chi' heb' winh. Haxo heb' winh sacerdote ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh rey, haton winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yuninal winhaj Abiatar yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' winh sacerdote chi' yet' t'a skal heb' winh levita, testigo yajkan heb' winh.

Haton sb'i heb' winh tik ix kannhej t'a junjun makan t'a stzolal, icha syal sb'i heb' winh yajalil heb' winh ix sik'an sorteo chi', schael yich t'a heb' winh b'ab'el masanto t'a heb' winh slajwub', 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil: Winhaj Joiarib, winhaj Jedaías, winhaj Harim, winhaj Seorim, winhaj Malquías, winhaj Mijamín, winhaj Cos, winhaj Abías, winhaj Jesúa, winhaj Secanías, winhaj Eliasib, winhaj Jaquim, winhaj Hupa, winhaj Jesebeab, winhaj Bilga, winhaj Imer, winhaj Hezir, winhaj Afses, winhaj Petaías, winhaj Hezequiel, winhaj Jaquín, winhaj Gamul, winhaj Delaía yet' winhaj Maazías.

Haton heb' winh tik ix pojchajek' t'a stzolal t'a sacerdoteal yik smunlaj heb' winh t'a templo, icha syal sley Jehová ko Diosal a onh israel onh tik, icha ajnak yalan t'a winhaj Aarón smam yicham heb' winh.
Haton sb'i heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal juntzanhxo heb' winh yinhtilal Leví tik: Haton winhaj Jehedías yinhtilal winhaj Subael, yinhtilal pax winhaj Amram.
Winhaj Isías b'ab'el t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Rehabías.
Winhaj Jahat yinhtilal winhaj Selomot, yinhtilal pax winhaj Izhar.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Jerías, winhaj Amarías, winhaj Jahaziel yet' winhaj Jecamán.
Winhaj Samir yinhtilal winhaj Micaía, yinhtilal pax winhaj Uziel.
Winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Isías yuk'tak winhaj Micaía.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Musi yet' winhaj Jaazías.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jaazías chi': Haton winhaj Beno, winhaj Soham, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Ibri.
Chawanh yuninal winhaj Mahli chi': Haton winhaj Eleazar yet' winhaj Cis. Ha winhaj Eleazar chi', malaj yuninal winh. Haxo pax winhaj Cis chi', ay jun yuninal winh, haton winhaj Jerameel.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Musi chi': Haton winhaj Mahli, winhaj Edar yet' winhaj Jerimot. Haton heb' winh chi' yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví.

Hanhejtona' heb' winh chi', t'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal smunlaji, icha ix sk'ulej heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb' winh, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón. Haton t'a yichanh winhaj rey David yet' winhaj Sadoc yet' winhaj Ahimelec yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' yinhtilal Leví yet' heb' winh sacerdote, hata' ix och sorteo chi'. Lajannhej ix aj heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal winh b'ab'el winak yet' t'a skal yinhtilal winh tzak'anto.

Ha winhaj rey David yet' heb' yajalil heb' soldado, ix sik'el heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf heb', winhaj Hemán yet' winhaj Jedutún, yik skuchb'an heb' anima heb' ayik tz'och heb' ejmelal t'a Dios, yik syalanel slolonel Dios heb' yet' sonal arpa, salterio yet' pax platillo. Haton sb'i heb' ayoch t'a yopisio tik:

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Asaf chi', haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Zacur, winhaj José, winhaj Netanías yet' winhaj Asarela. Ha winhaj Asaf chi' skuchb'an heb' winh. Ha winh tz'alanel slolonel Dios ayik syalan winh rey chi' t'a winh.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Jedutún, wakwanh heb' winh: Haton winhaj Gedalías, winhaj Zeri, winhaj Jesaías, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Matatías yet' winhaj Simei. Ha winhaj Jedutún chi' skuchb'an heb' winh, syalanpax slolonel Dios heb' winh yet' arpa yik tz'alji yuj diosal yet' yalchaj wach' lolonel t'a Jehová t'a b'ital.

Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hemán, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Buquías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Uziel, winhaj Sebuel, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Hanani, winhaj Eliata, winhaj Gidalti, winhaj Romanti-ezer, winhaj Josbecasa, winhaj Maloti, winhaj Hotir yet' winhaj Mahaziot.

Ha heb' winh chi' yuninal heb' winh winhaj Hemán. Ha winhaj Hemán chi', schekab' Dios yaj winh, a winh tz'ak'an razón t'a winh rey. 14 yuninal winh ix yak' Dios yet' oxwanh yisil winh, yik tz'elk'och sti' Dios yak'nak t'a winh, ayik yalannak to niwan ol ajelk'och winh.

Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', a winh smam heb' winh skuchb'an t'a b'it yik tz'och ejmelal t'a stemplo Jehová yet' juntzanh yamk'ab', haton platillo, salterio yet' arpa. Ha winhaj Asaf, winhaj Jedutún yet' winhaj Hemán ayoch heb' winh t'a yalanh scheknab'il winh rey.
Ha sb'isul heb' winh k'ayb'annak sb'itan t'a Jehová chi' yet' yinhtilal, 288 heb' winh t'a smasanil.
T'a sorteoal ix aj yoch heb' winh sb'itani, tz'och heb' winh ichamtak winak yet' heb' winh kelemtak, heb' winh k'ayb'umxo yet' heb' winh wanto sk'ayb'ani.

Ayik ix lajwi yoch sorteo chi', icha tik ix aj yoch heb' winh t'a stzolal, 24 makan heb' winh t'a smasanil. Lajchawanh sb'ey heb' winh t'a junjun makan, aynhej yuj sb'a heb' winh. Ha t'a skal junjun makan heb' winh, ay junjun heb' winh skuchb'an heb' winh, haton heb' winh tik, schael yich t'a winh b'ab'el masanto t'a winh slajwub': Winhaj José, winhaj Gedalías, winhaj Zacur, winhaj Izri, winhaj Netanías, winhaj Buquías, winhaj Jesarela, winhaj Jesahías, winhaj Matanías, winhaj Simei, winhaj Azareel, winhaj Hasabías, winhaj Subael, winhaj Matatías, winhaj Jeremot, winhaj Hananías, winhaj Josbecasa, winhaj Hanani, winhaj Maloti, winhaj Eliata, winhaj Hotir, winhaj Gidalti, winhaj Mahaziot, winhaj Romanti-ezer.
Hanhejtona' t'a stzolal ix aj spojchajb'at heb' winh tanhwum puerta, icha tik ix aj heb' winh: Haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coré: Ha winhaj Meselemías yuninal winhaj Coré yinhtilal winhaj Asaf.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Meselemías chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Zacarías, winhaj Jediael, winhaj Zebadías, winhaj Jatniel,
winhaj Elam, winhaj Johanán yet' winhaj Elioenai.

Ix yak' swach'k'olal Dios t'a yib'anh winhaj Obed-edom, yuj chi' tzijtum yuninal winh. Haton stzolal sb'i heb' winh tik: Winhaj Semaías, winhaj Jozabad, winhaj Joa, winhaj Sacar, winhaj Natanael, winhaj Amiel, winhaj Isacar yet' winhaj Peultai.
Haxo winhaj Semaías chi', ay heb' winh yuninal winh te niwak ix aj yelk'ochi, yuj chi' yajal ix aj heb' t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Semaías chi', haton heb' tik: Winhaj Otni, winhaj Rafael, winhaj Obed, winhaj Elzabad, winhaj Eliú yet' winhaj Samaquías.

Masanil heb' winh tik, yinhtilal heb' winh winhaj Obed-edom. Masanil heb' winh uninab'il yet' heb' winh sk'ab'yok heb', te tek'an heb' winh, ay yip heb' winh smunlaji, 62 sb'isul heb' winh t'a smasanil.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Meselemías yet' heb' sk'ab'yok winh, 18 heb', te jelan heb'.
Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hosa, yinhtilal winhaj Merari: Haton winhaj Simri. Wach'chom manhok winh b'ab'el uninab'il yaji, a winh smam winh ix ak'anoch yajalil.
Haxo heb' yuk'tak winh: Haton winhaj Hilcías schab'il, yoxil winhaj Tebalías, schanhil winhaj Zacarías. Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Hosa yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, 13 heb' t'a smasanil.
Ix pojchajek' heb' stanhwan stemplo Jehová yet' heb' yajalil heb', icha ix aj juntzanhxo heb' yetlevitail heb'.
Sorteoal ix aj sch'oxji tas puertail stanhwej junjun makan heb', ayoch heb' kelemtak yet' heb' ichamtak winak.

Ha winhaj Selemías yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u. Haxo winhaj Zacarías yuninal winhaj Selemías chi', jelan yak'an razón winh. Ha winh ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal norte yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok.
Haxo winhaj Obed-edom yet' heb' ayoch yet'ok ix tanhwan puerta t'a stojolal sur. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh ix tanhwan b'aj sik'chaj tas ay t'a templo.

Haxo winhaj Supim yet' winhaj Hosa yet' heb' ayoch yet' heb' winh, a heb' winh ix tanhwan puerta chi' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u yet' jun puerta yik Salequet b'aj sk'e b'e. Ha heb' winh kuchb'um chi', t'a stzolal tz'aj stanhwan puerta chi' heb' winh.

Junjun k'u, ay wakwanh heb' winh stanhwan puerta t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, chanhwanh heb' winh t'a stojolal norte, chanhwanh pax heb' winh t'a stojolal sur, haxo pax b'aj sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a Jehová chi', chatakwanh heb' winh stanhwan junjun puerta.
Haxo t'a yamaq'uil templo t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, chanhwanh heb' winh stanhwan t'a sti' scalleal, chawanh pax heb' winh stanhwan t'a yamaq'uil chi'.
Ichaton chi' ix aj spojchajek' opisio chi' t'a skal heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Coré yet' yik winhaj Merari.
Ay pax juntzanhxo heb' yetlevitail heb' tz'ilan b'aj sik'chaj tas yik Jehová yaji yet' b'aj smolchaj ofrenda tz'ak'ji t'ay.
Ha winhaj Jehiel yuninal winhaj Laadán, t'a yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, a winh yajal yaj t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok.
Haxo pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Jehiel chi', haton winhaj Zetam yet' winhaj Joel, a heb' winh ayoch t'a yib'anh stanhwan b'aj sik'chaj tas ay t'a skajnub' Jehová.
Ix ak'chajpaxoch heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Amram t'a yopisio, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Izhar, winhaj Hebrón yet' winhaj Uziel.
Ha winhaj Sebuel, yinhtilal winhaj Gersón yuninal winhaj Moisés, a winh tz'ilan wal juntzanh tas ay t'a skajnub' Jehová.

Ha winhaj Sebuel chi', sk'ab'yok sb'a winh yet' winhaj Selomit, yujto a smam yicham winhaj Selomit chi', haton winhaj Eliezer yuk'tak winhaj Gersón smam yicham winhaj Sebuel chi'. Ha heb' smam yicham winhaj Selomit chi' t'a stzolal: Haton winhaj Zicri, winhaj Joram, winhaj Jesaías, winhaj Rehabías yet' winhaj Eliezer.
Ha winhaj Selomit yet' heb' sk'ab'yok stanhwan tastak ak'b'il yikok Jehová yuj winhaj rey David yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a skal junjun makan yinhtilal yet' heb' niwak yajalil heb' soldado.
Ha juntzanh tas ix yak' heb' chi', haton tastak ix yik' heb' b'ajtak ix laj och owal, ix yak' heb' yik sk'anchaj t'a stemplo Jehová.

Hata' aypaxkan masanil tas yak'nakkan winhaj Samuel schekab' Dios, winhaj Saúl yuninal winhaj Cis, winhaj Abner yuninal winhaj Ner yet' winhaj Joab yune' ix Sarvia. Masanil juntzanh ak'b'il yikok Jehová chi', a winhaj Selomit yet' heb' sk'ab'yok ix tanhwani.

Ha t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Izhar kotnak winhaj Quenanías yet' heb' winh yuninal yet' heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha heb' chi', manhxook t'a stemplo Jehová ix och heb' t'a yopisio, palta to ix och heb' t'a niwak yajalil yet' juezal t'a chonhab' Israel.

Ha winhaj Hasabías yet' heb' sk'ab'yok, haton heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón, ay mil 700 sb'isul heb', te jelan heb'. Ix ak'jioch yopisio heb' yilan tastak yik Jehová yaji yet' masanil tastak yik winh rey t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u.

Haxo pax t'a sk'axepal ha' Jordán chi', b'aj kajan heb' yinhtilal Rubén, heb' yinhtilal Gad yet' nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés, a winhaj Jerías yet' 2 mil 700 heb' sk'ab'yok, ix ak'jipaxoch heb' t'a yopisio chi'. Yinhtilal pax heb' winhaj Hebrón. Ayik 40 ab'ilxo yoch winhaj David reyal, hata' ix saychajeq'ui b'ajtak kajan heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Hebrón. Ix ilchaji to ay heb' kajan t'a Jazer t'a yol yik Galaad, te jelan pax heb', yuj chi' ix ak'jioch heb' t'a jun opisio chi'.

Junjun ujal tz'och 24 mil heb' winh winak t'a soldadoal. Ha t'a skal heb' winh ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal, ay heb' winh niwak yajalil heb' soldado yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' tz'ilan tastak yik winh rey. Haton sb'i heb' winh ayoch yajalil tik, t'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' winh t'a junjun uj.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj a winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Zabdiel yinhtilal winhaj Fares tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a schab'il uj, a winhaj Dodai aj Aho tz'ochi. Haxo winhaj Miclot schab'il yajal yaji.
Haxo t'a yoxil uj, a winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj sat sacerdote Joiada tz'ochi.
Ha winhaj Benaía chi', yajal yaj winh t'a 30 heb' soldado te b'inajnak, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Amisabad, schab'il yajal yaj winh t'a jun makan heb' soldado tz'och t'a jun uj chi'.
Haxo t'a schanhil uj, a winhaj Asael yuk'tak winhaj Joab aykanoch sb'i t'ay, palta haxo winhaj Zebadías yuninal winh ayoch yajalil sk'exulok.
Haxo t'a yoil uj, a winhaj Samhut yinhtilal Izhar tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a swakil uj, a winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a yukil uj, a winhaj Heles aj Pelón, yinhtilal Efraín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a swajxakil uj, a winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, yinhtilal winhaj Zera tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a sb'alunhil uj, a winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot, yinhtilal Benjamín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a slajunhil uj, a winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, yinhtilal winhaj Zera tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a yuxluchil uj, a winhaj Benaía aj Piratón, yinhtilal Efraín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a slajchawil uj, a winhaj Heldai aj Netofa, yinhtilal winhaj Otoniel tz'ochi.

Haxo pax heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal Israel, haton heb' winh tik: Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Rubén, a winhaj Eliezer yuninal winhaj Zicri yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, a winhaj Sefatías yuninal winhaj Maaca yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, a winhaj Hasabías yuninal winhaj Kemuel yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, a winhaj Sadoc yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, a winhaj Eliú yuk'tak winhaj rey David yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, a winhaj Omri yuninal winhaj Micael yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, a winhaj Ismaías yuninal winhaj Abdías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, a winhaj Jerimot yuninal winhaj Azriel yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, a winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Azazías yajal yaji. Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, a winhaj Joel yuninal winhaj Pedaías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a Galaad, a winhaj Iddo yuninal winhaj Zacarías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, a winhaj Jaasiel yuninal winhaj Abner yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, a winhaj Azareel yuninal winhaj Jeroham yajal yaji. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal Israel.

Ayik ix yalan winhaj rey David to sb'ischaj masanil heb' israel, ix yalan winh to max b'ischajlaj heb' manto tz'akwi t'a 20 ab'il sk'inal, yujto yak'nak sti' Jehová to ol yik' wal chaanh sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Israel icha sb'isul k'een k'anal.

Ix schael yich winhaj Joab yik'anchaanh sb'isul heb' yetisraelal chi', palta maj lajwoklaj yik'anchaanh winh, yujto yuj jun chi' ix kot jun niwan yaelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Yuj chi' a sb'isul heb' chi' manh tz'ib'ab'ilok t'a yab'ixal winhaj rey David.

Ha winhaj Azmavet yuninal winhaj Adiel tz'ilan tastak ay t'a winh rey. Haxo winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Uzías tz'ilani jantak tas molan t'a junjun chonhab', t'a junjun aldea yet' t'a junjun cuartel ay t'a sattak mojon.
Haxo winhaj Ezri yuninal winhaj Quelub tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a sluum winh rey chi'.
Haxo winhaj Simei aj Ramat tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a te' yuwa winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Zabdi aj Safat tz'ilan heb' smolb'an wino t'a yet'tal.
Haxo winhaj Baal-hanán aj Gedera tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a te' olivo yet' t'a te' kaltakte'al higo ay t'a panhkiltak. Haxo winhaj Joás tz'ilan heb' smolan aceite yik sat te' olivo.
Haxo winhaj Sitrai aj Sarón tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' wakax ay t'a Sarón chi'. Haxo pax winhaj Safat yuninal winhaj Adlai tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' wakax ay t'a panhkiltak.
Haxo winhaj Obil ismaelita tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' camello. Haxo winhaj Jehedías aj Meronot tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' b'uru.
Haxo winhaj Jaziz agareno tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa. Haton masanil heb' winh tik tz'ilan masanil tastak ay t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Ha winhaj Jonatán yicham winhaj rey David chi', tz'ib'um winh, te jelan pax winh, ak'um razón yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Jehiel yuninal winhaj Hacmoni tz'ilan heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi'.
Yet' pax winhaj Ahitofel ak'um razón yajpax winh t'a winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Husai arquita, te wach' yak'an winh rey chi' yet' winh.
Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Ahitofel chi', a winhaj Joiada yuninal winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Abiatar ix ochkan sk'exulok winh. Haxo winhaj Joab sat yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado winh rey chi'.

Ha t'a Jerusalén ix smolb'ej masanil heb' yajal yaj t'a chonhab' Israel winhaj rey David: Haton heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal, heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' soldado tz'ilan winh rey chi' yet' heb' sat yajal yaj t'a junjun niwak nhilanh heb' soldado. Ix smolb'ejpax heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ilan tastak ay t'a winh rey chi', haton masanil lum lum yet' masanil nok' nok', heb' tz'ilan heb' winh yuninal winh, heb' ayoch t'a yopisio yet' winh yet' masanil heb' soldado te tek'an yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh niwan yelk'ochi.

Ixlajwi chi' ix k'e linhan winh, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ab'ek he masanil ex wetchonhab'. Ay wal och t'a in pensar in b'oank'e junok templo b'aj skan te' skaxail strato Jehová t'a junelnhej, yik wach' hata' skajnaj ko Diosal chi'. Toxo ix in molb'ej masanil tastak ol k'anchaj t'ay.
Palta ix yal Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Manhok ach ol a b'ok'e jun in kajnub' chi', yujto ak'um ach owal, manh jantakok anima a milnakchamok, xchi t'ayin.

Palta a Jehová ko Diosal chi' ix in sik'ankaneli yik tzin och reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik t'a junelnhej, yujto ha' ix sik'anel yinhtilal Judá, yik syak'an yajalil t'a masanil kinhtilal. Haxo t'a yinhtilal Judá chi', a yinhtilal winh in mam ix sik'kaneli, haxo pax t'a yinhtilal winh in mam chi', a in ix in sik'el t'a skal heb' wuk'tak yik tzin och reyal t'a ko chonhab' tik.
Haxo tiknaik, ha t'a skal jantak heb' wuninal ix yak' Jehová chi', hata' ix sik'el winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, yik tz'ochkan winh reyal in k'exulok t'a ko chonhab' tik.

Ix yalanpax Jehová chi' t'ayin icha tik: Ha winh uninal aj Salomón, a winh ol b'oank'e jun in kajnub' yet' yamaq'uil, yujto a in ix in sik'kanel winh yik tz'ochkan winh wuninalok, a inxo ol in ochkan smamok winh.
Hanhejtona' ol wak'kan yopisio winh t'a junelnhej, tato ol stek'b'ej wal sb'a winh sk'anab'ajan masanil in cheknab'il yet' masanil in k'ayb'ub'al, icha sk'ulej winh tiknaik, xchi Jehová t'ayin.

Ha tiknaik jun, wal t'a eyichanh he masanil ex wetchonhab', schonhab' Jehová yet' t'a yichanh ko Diosal tz'ab'an tas skala', scham wal walan t'ayex to tze b'eyb'alej wal masanil scheknab'il Jehová ko Diosal. Tze k'anab'ajani, yik wach' ol ex kajnajnhej t'a jun chonhab' manhxo jantakok swach'il tik. Ha exxo ol eyak'kan smakb'enok heb' eyuninal t'a junelnhej.

Ha hachxo tik ach wuninal aj Salomón, ojtakej wal ko Diosal, tza k'anab'ajan wal yet' smasanil a k'ool. Yujto a Jehová yojtak masanil tas sko na' yet' tas sko nib'ej. Tato ol al a b'a t'ay, ol tak'wok t'ayach, palta tato ol ik'kanel a b'a t'ay jun, ol ach spatikejkanel t'a junelnhej.
Ha tiknaik a Jehová ix ach sik'aneli yik ol a b'ok'e jun templo b'aj ol kajnajok, yuj chi' tek'an wal tzutej a b'a, ochokab' munlajel, xchi winhaj rey David chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'an yumal winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi', haton yechel tas ol aj sb'o yamaq'uil yet' juntzanh cuarto b'aj ol sik'chaj tas tz'ak'ji yikok Jehová yet' juntzanh cuarto ol kan t'a chaanh yet' juntzanh cuarto ol kan t'a yol templo chi' yet' jun lugar b'aj tz'ak'ji tup mul.

Ix yak'anpax yumal masanil tas nab'ilxo yuj winh, haton tas ol aj sb'o yamaq'uil templo chi' yet' juntzanh cuarto ol och t'a spatiktak b'aj ol sik'chaj masanil syamk'ab'il yet' juntzanh tas tz'ak'ji silab'il t'a Dios.
Ix yak'anpax yumal winh tas ol aj yoch heb' sacerdote yet' heb' levita t'a stzolal yik ol munlaj heb' t'a templo chi' yet' slistail jantak yamk'ab' yik ejmelal ol och t'a Jehová.
Ix yak'an slistail winh jantak k'een oro yet' jantak k'een plata ol och t'a junjun makan juntzanh syamk'ab'il templo chi':
Ix yalanpax winh yuj jantak yalil ol aj junjun sb'akhnub'al candil yet' junjun scandilal chi', tato oro, mato plata.
Icha pax chi' ix aj yalan winh yuj juntzanh mexa ol och oro t'ay b'aj ol em tzolan ixim pan to yik Jehová yaji yet' juntzanh mexa ol och plata t'ay.

Ix yalanpax winh yuj jantak k'een oro ol och t'a k'een niwak tenedor yik chib'ej, t'a k'een niwak uk'ab' yet' t'a k'een niwak xalu yet' jantak k'een oro, ma k'een plata ol och t'a k'een kopa yet' t'a juntzanhxo k'een icha jantak yalil junjun makan.

Ix yalpax winh yuj jantak k'een oro te wach' ol och t'a jun altar yik incienso. Ix yalpax winh jantak k'een oro ol k'anchaj t'a jun carruaje, haton juntzanh yechel querubín jenhanb'at sk'axil t'a yib'anh te' skaxail strato Jehová Dios.
Masanil juntzanh chi', tz'ib'ab'ilkani, yujto a wal Jehová ix ak'an nachajel yuj winhaj rey David chi' tas ol aj sb'o jun munlajel chi', icha ix aj yechel.

Yuj chi', ix yalanpax winhaj rey David chi' t'a winhaj Salomón chi' icha tik: Tek'an wal tzutej a b'a, ochokab' munlajel. Manh ak' chab'axk'e a k'ool, manh ach xiwok, yujto a Jehová ko Diosal manh ol ach yaktejkani. Ol ochnhej het'ok yik ol yik'elk'och sb'a jun munlajel t'a jun templo tik.

Haton heb' sacerdote tik yet' heb' levita, icha syal jay makan heb', te b'ekan sk'ol heb' smunlaj t'a templo chi'. Te b'ekanpax sk'ool masanil heb' winh winak smunlaji, heb' jelan spensar smunlaj t'a yalnhej tas munlajelal yet' heb' yajal yaji. Masanil pax heb' anima, ol sk'anab'ajej heb' tas ol ala', xchi winh t'a winhaj Salomón chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', ix yalan winhaj rey David chi' t'a masanil heb' anima molanek' chi' icha tik: Ex wetchonhab', anhej wal winh wuninal aj Salomón tik ix sik'jiel yuj Dios, palta yune' kelemto winh. Haxo pax jun munlajel tik te niwan, yujto a jun templo chi' manh yikok anima, palta to skajnub' Jehová Dios ol ajok.

Ix wak' wal wip in molb'an masanil tastak ol k'anchaj t'a stemplo ko Diosal chi': Haton k'een oro, k'een plata, k'een bronce, k'een hierro yet' te te', icha jantak ol k'anchaj t'a junjun makan munlajel. Te niwan k'een kornalina ix in molb'ej yet' juntzanhxo k'een k'een tz'och yelwanub'ok yet' tzijtum makanhil k'een k'een wach' yilji, manh jantakok pax k'een mármol.
Ha yet' jantak tas molb'ab'ilxo chi' wuuj yik sb'ochaj templo chi', swak'anpax jantak k'een oro yet' k'een plata to yel wiko', yujto te xajan stemplo in Diosal wuuj.
Haton 2 mil 300 quintal k'een oro te wach' yet' 5 mil 300 quintal k'een plata, te wach' pax yaj k'een sb'oi, yik tz'och k'een t'a sattak yol templo yet' juntzanh cuarto,
yet' t'a juntzanhxo munlajel ol sb'o heb' munlajwum t'a k'een oro, ma t'a k'een plata chi'. Haxo tiknaik, ¿mach ex wal b'ekan he k'ol eyak'an he kolwal t'a Jehová? xchi winh rey chi'.

Yuj chi', a heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' sk'ab'yok, heb' yajal yaj t'a junjun inhtilal heb' yetisraelal, heb' niwak yajalil heb' soldado yet' heb' yajal yaj t'a heb' tz'ilan smunlajel winh rey, masanil heb' chi', ix el wal t'a sk'ol heb' yak'an skolwal.

Ix laj yak' skolwal heb' yik sb'ochaj templo chi': 3 mil 800 quintal k'een oro, 7 mil 600 quintal k'een plata, 13 mil 500 quintal k'een bronce yet' pax 75 mil quintal k'een hierro, masanil juntzanh k'een chi' ix yak' heb'.
Yet' pax heb' b'aj ay k'een k'een wach' yilji, ix yak' k'een heb' t'a winhaj Jehiel yinhtilal winhaj Gersón, yujto a winh schaan masanil tas tz'ak'ji yik sb'ochaj templo chi'.
Ix tzalaj wal masanil anima yuj jantak tas ix yak' heb' yajal chi', yujto t'a smasanil sk'ol heb' ix yak' juntzanh chi' t'a Jehová. Hanhejtona' ix te tzalajpax winhaj rey David chi' yet' heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yal wach' lolonel winh t'a Jehová t'a yichanh masanil heb' anima chi', ix yalan winh icha tik: Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, sDiosal ach pax winh ko mam kicham Israel. Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'ayach t'a masanil tiempo.
Ik yaj smasanil tas, te niwan elk'ochi, ay a poder, ay a tzikikial, Yajal ach t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a sat lu'um tik.
Ha ach tzak' b'eyumal yik tzonh ik'anchaanh. Yajal ach t'a yib'anh smasanil. Ha t'a yol a k'ab' ay masanil ipalil. Tzak' sniwanil yelk'ochi yet' poder t'a heb' b'aj a gana ak'ani.
Yuj wal chi' ach ko Diosal, skak' yuj diosal, skalanpax wach' lolonel t'ayach yuj a b'inajnakil.
Wal yel, a in tik yet' heb' wetchonhab' tik, malaj wal jab'ok tas syal ko sian t'ayach, yujto masanil juntzanh tik a t'ayach skoti, yuj chi' a tas tzak' t'ayonh, ha' skak'pax t'ayach.
Ha onh tik, ek'elb'anhej tzonh ek' t'a tik. Mamin, lajan kek' icha ajnak yek' heb' ko mam kicham. Ha ko k 'inal t'a sat lu'um tik, lajan icha xob'al lum lum, manh najtilok tzonh eq'ui.
Yuj chi' Mamin Jehová ko Diosal, ik yaj masanil juntzanh b'eyumal tik. Ha t'ayach skot masanil juntzanh tas ix ko molb'ej tik yik sko b'oank'e jun templo yuj ach kik'anchaanh.

Mamin, wojtak wal to tza ch'olb'itej ko pensar, anhej wal tojolal scha a k'ool. Yuj chi' t'a wal smasanil in k'ool swak' juntzanh tik t'a yol a k'ab'. Ha tiknaik, swil t'a tzalajk'olal to a masanil heb' a chonhab' molanek' tik, wal t'a smasanil sk'ool heb' yet' stzalajk'olal heb' syak' silab' t'ayach.

Mamin Jehová, ko Diosal ach, sDiosal ach pax heb' ko mam kicham, haton winhaj Abraham, winhaj Isaac yet' winhaj Israel. Ak'nhejoch t'a spensar heb' a chonhab' tik, yik tz'elnhej t'a sk'ol heb' yak'ani. Yak'okab' wal och sb'a heb' t'a yol a k'ab'.

Hanhejtona' tzak'an wach' pensaril t'a winh wuninal aj Salomón tik, yik sk'anab'ajej masanil a cheknab'il winh yet' a k'ayb'ub'al t'a smasanil sk'ool, sb'eyb'alanpax winh, yik ol yal sb'oank'e jun templo winh, jun ix in molb'ejkan tas ol och t'ay, xchi winhaj rey David chi' t'a slesal.

Ixlajwi chi' ix yalanxi winh t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha tiknaik ex wetchonhab', alek wach' lolonel t'a Jehová ko Diosal, xchi winh. Yuj chi' masanil heb' anima chi' ix halan wach' lolonel t'a Jehová Dios, haton sDiosal pax smam yicham heb'. Ix em kuman heb', ix empax nhojan heb' t'a yichanh Dios ayik ayek' heb' t'a yichanh winh rey chi'.

Haxo t'a junxo k'u, ix snhusan silab' heb' t'a Jehová: Mil nok' kelemtak wakax, mil nok' ch'ak kalnel, mil nok' yunetak kalnel. Ix yak'pax wino heb', haton tz'ak'jitaxon yet' junjun makan nok' silab'. Te niwan nok' silab' ix yak' heb' yik schi'an nok' heb' smasanil.

Ha wal t'a jun k'u chi', ix wa heb', ix yuk'an ha' heb' t'a tzalajk'olal t'a yichanh Jehová. Ix yak'ank'e aceite heb' t'a sjolom winhaj Salomón yuninal winhaj rey David t'a yichanh Jehová t'a schaelal, yik tz'ochkan winh sreyalok heb'. Ix yak'anpaxk'e aceite heb' t'a sjolom winhaj Sadoc yik tz'ochkan winh sat sacerdoteal.
Icha chi' ix aj yoch winhaj Salomón reyal sk'exulok winh smam t'a yopisio ix yak' Jehová. Te wach' ix aj yelk'och winh yet' yopisio chi'. Masanil heb' israel ix k'anab'ajan winh.
Masanil heb' yajal yaji, heb' soldado yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj rey David, ix yak' sti' heb' sk'anab'ajan winhaj rey Salomón chi'.
Ix ik'ji wal chaanh winhaj Salomón chi' yuj Jehová t'a yichanh chonhab' Israel, ix ak'ji sb'inajnakil winh yuj. Malaj junok sreyal Israel ek'nakxo icha ix aj sb'inaj winh chi'.

Ha winhaj rey David, yuninal winhaj Isaí, 40 ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a Israel. Uke' ab'il ix yak' reyal winh t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá t'a Hebrón, 33 ab'il ix yak'pax reyal winh t'a masanil heb' israel t'a Jerusalén.
Te b'eyum ix aj winh, te niwan pax ix aj yelk'och winh. Ichamilxo ix ik'an scham winh, ak'ank'olal ix cham winh. Haxo winhaj Salomón winh yuninal winh ix ochkan reyal sk'exulok.
Ha jantakto yab'ixal winhaj rey David chi', yiktax ix schaanel yich winh masanto ix cham winh, aykan b'aj tz'ib'ab'il yuj heb' schekab' Dios, haton winhaj Samuel, winhaj Natán yet' winhaj Gad.
Hata' tz'ib'ab'ilkan masanil tas ix sk'ulej winh t'a yopisio, sniwanil yelk'och winh, masanil tastak ix ek' t'a yib'anh winh yet' t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel yet' t'a yib'anh juntzanhxo nación.
